nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Road Warrior / My Fair Chipette: More adventures with the pint-sized chipmunks. And Alvin, who is also a chipmunk, and therefore of broadly similar size.

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon's game launch is disrupted by Jeanette's changes in 'The Return of Thornbergaupht', then in 'Squashed', Alvin ropes Dave into playing squash. (S5, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin and Brittany wind up in a battle royale in 'Bubble Wrap', and in 'Chess Mate', a cute girl joins the chess club, so Alvin enlists Jeanette to teach him to play so he can join too. (S5, ep 21)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Eleanor enters a knight competition in 'A Knight's Tail', and then in 'Dreambomber', Alvin is having the best dreams of his life, until Theodore subconsciously invades them. (S5, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore gets stuck taking care of Miss Croner's cats in 'The Cat Sitter', then in 'Addicted', The Chipettes challenge the Chipmunks to go three hours without their favourite things. (S3, ep 3)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon goes missing and no one else notices in 'Oh Brother Where Art Thou', then in 'The Wall', the girls at school cast votes for the cutest chipmunk on the bathroom wall. (S3, ep 6)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The boys accidently break Dave's new flat screen TV in 'The Fugitives', and in 'Sherlock Chipmunk', Jeanette and Eleanor act as Sherlock Holmes and Watson when Theodore's teddy disappears. (S3, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin must prove that alien life exists in 'Across the Universe', and in 'Britt's Picks', Brittany's furious when she thinks Alvin has been writing on her blog, and vows to get him back? (S3, ep 19)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon's plant experiment creates a growing monster in 'A Rose By Another Name', then in 'Queen Bee', Brittany admires bees after living as one. (S3, ep 20)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Brittany dreams of being a fashion designer in 'The Devil Wears Rodentia', then in 'Career Day', Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously. (S3, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Miss Miller gets robbed in 'The Great Chipmunk Detective', and in 'Guitar Hero', Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she needs to learn. (S3, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Coach Dobkins challenges Miss Smith to a baseball game in 'The C Team', then in 'Father Daughter Dance', The Chipettes each want Dave to be their date for the dance. (S3, ep 26)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Eleanor decides to move in with Alvin and his brothers in 'Sister Act', then in 'Lil' T', Theodore posts a video of himself rapping on the Internet and it becomes a mega-hit! (S1, ep 3)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dave refuses to let Alvin get a dangerous toy sports car in 'Safety Third', then in 'Mister Manners', Alvin must pass a manners course before he gets his dream meeting with a Princess. (S1, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The girls are remembering their home in 'The Tree House', then in 'Saving Simon', Alvin and Theodore think that Simon is going away to a boarding school, and try to keep him at home. (S1, ep 15)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Jeanette signs The Chipmunks and Chipettes up for a competition in 'Going Green', then in 'Tattle Tail', Alvin likes a girl at school so he agrees to look after her talking bird. (S1, ep 18)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Super Heroes: When Theodore thinks he's a real superhero, Alvin and Simon have a tough time convincing him to leave the crime fighting to the professionals. (S1, ep 37)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: I Will Survive: When Alvin gets hurt, Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a survival reality show, where there's room for only one winner. Is playing dirty the only way to win? (S1, ep 48)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Deserted: After getting detention again, Alvin's convinced Dave will drive him to the desert and abandon him there. (S5, ep 1a)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and the Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Yeti or Not: On a ski trip, Alvin convinces Theodore there's a Yeti nearby, making life miserable for the rest of the family. (S5, ep 3b)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Jeanette is proclaimed a fashion trendsetter by Brittany's icon in 'She's Got Style', then in 'Super Heroes', Theodore thinks he's a real superhero, and Alvin and Simon can't convince him. (S1, ep 19)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks argue over who is best suited to lead them to victory in 'Mutiny', then in 'Reality or Not', Alvin is tired of seeing his celebrity status overshadowed by Reality TV stars. (S1, ep 22)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Eleanor has prepared a cake for a Bake-Off in 'Let Them Eat Crumbs', and in 'Who Ghosts There', worried that Dave will move the family to his dream house, the boys make it seem haunted. (S1, ep 23)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks have 48 hours to help Jeanette make a film in 'Lights Camera Uh-Oh', then in 'Wax Dave', The Chipmunks fear Dave is in love with a woman who wants to turn him into a statue! (S2, ep 4)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Brittany is preparing a class speech on inner beauty in 'Suck Toad', then in 'Secret Admirer', Alvin believes that Kevin has a secret crush on one of the Chipettes. (S2, ep 11)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipettes set out to prove that being a superhero isn't just a guy thing in 'Super Girls', then in 'Held Back', Alvin must pass his next test, or be separated from his brothers. (S2, ep 15)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Brittany is hurt before a major school event in 'The Temp', and in 'Parent Trap', Bocarter's father helps him with his class project, so Alvin gets Dave's help, bringing heated competion. (S2, ep 18)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore tries to overcome his fear of sleep-overs in 'Theo's Big Night Out', then in 'The Bodyguard', Alvin decides he needs a personal bodyguard, and trains Theodore for the job. (S3, ep 24)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Brittany takes up painting to impress her fashion idol in 'Art For Art's Sake', and then in 'Mancave', Alvin, convinced that Julie and her son are trying to move in, tries to stop it. (S1, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: When Alvin finally pushes Miss Smith too far, she quits in 'Missing Miss Smith', then in 'Monster Madness', Alvin and Simon tease The Chipettes about being scared by a movie. (S2, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a reality show in 'I Will Survive', then in 'Alvin's Got A Brand New Bag', Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's bag and must replace it. (S1, ep 26)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipettes fall in love with a cute little mouse in 'Of Mice and Munks', and in 'Simon Saves the World', Simon's new invention creates a time loop and changing gravity inside the house. (S4, ep 24)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The boys build a treehouse in the backyard and move out in 'Independence Day', and in 'Opposites Attract', an invention of Simon's accidently magnetizes Alvin and Simon to each other. (S3, ep 11)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Jeanette decides to plant a garden on the school grounds in 'Jeanette's Secret Garden', then in 'Treasure Hunt', the Chipmunks set off in search of lost treasure. (S2, ep 22)

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Beauty Shop
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Far from Chicago, hairdresser Gina Norris has relocated to Atlanta with her daughter and has quickly established herself as a rare talent in her profession. But after repeatedly butting heads with her shady, over-the-top boss, Jorge, Norris sets out to create her own salon -- even snagging a few of Jorge's employees and clients, including Lynn and Terri, respectively. Now, Jorge will do anything to shut her down. (Comedy, Movie, Romance) - 2005-03-30

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Presidio
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Ex-military policeman Jay Austin (Mark Harmon) is now a San Francisco detective. When his former MP partner is killed at a military base, he takes the case. But after arriving at the crime scene, he realizes he must look to his old rival, Lt. Col. Alan Caldwell (Sean Connery), for help. Austin then falls for Caldwell's daughter, Donna (Meg Ryan), further complicating matters. Still, the two men push on in their search, learning to respect one another as they pursue the killer. (Action, Crime, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1988-08-06

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Hunted
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: "The Hunted" is a suspense thriller about a tracker, Bonham (Tommy Lee Jones), who teams up with FBI agent Abby Durrell (Connie Nielsen) to hunt down a trained assassin Hallam (Benicio del Toro). With precision and skill, the predator remains one step ahead, and escapes into the city. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2003-03-14

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Zodiac
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: In the late 1960s and 1970s, fear grips the city of San Francisco as a serial killer called Zodiac stalks its residents. Investigators (Mark Ruffalo, Anthony Edwards) and reporters (Jake Gyllenhaal, Robert Downey Jr.) become obsessed with learning the killer's identity and bringing him to justice. Meanwhile, Zodiac claims victim after victim and taunts the authorities with cryptic messages, cyphers and menacing phone calls. (Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2007-03-02

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Gone Baby Gone
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Along with his girlfriend (Michelle Monaghan), a private detective (Casey Affleck) takes on the difficult task of searching for a kidnapped girl in Boston. During his investigation, he must deal with the girl's aunt, a disapproving lawman (Morgan Freeman) and a drug dealer. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Mystery) - 2007-10-19

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Out of Time
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Matt Lee Whitlock (Denzel Washington) is the police chief of a small Florida town, going through a divorce with his detective wife, Alex (Eva Mendes). He begins a passionate affair with Ann (Sanaa Lathan), only to find out that she's stricken with terminal cancer. Matt steals a large sum of money confiscated from a drug bust in order to pay for Ann's treatment -- but when she apparently dies in a suspicious fire, the money disappears, and all the clues point to Matt as the culprit. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2003-10-03

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Black Rain
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: New York City policemen Nick (Michael Douglas) and Charlie (Andy Garcia) witness a murder in a bar and quickly apprehend the assailant. The killer, named Sato (Yusaku Matsuda), is a member of Japan's infamous Yakuza mob, and Nick and Charlie must transport the gangster back to Osaka for his murder trial. There, Sato's fellow gangsters free him from police custody, forcing Nick and Charlie to scour Japan's dangerous underworld of organized crime in search of their fugitive. (Action, Adventure, Crime drama, Drama, Movie) - 1989-09-22

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Last Train From Gun Hill
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: As the wealthiest and most powerful man in the Wild West town of Gun Hill, cattle rancher Craig Belden (Anthony Quinn) has come to believe he's above the law. When his son, Rick (Earl Holliman), rapes and murders a Native American woman (Ziva Rodann) married to U.S. marshal Matt Morgan (Kirk Douglas), Belden arrogantly declines to allow his son's arrest. The marshal, once a friend of Belden's, takes on the rancher's henchmen and Rick's accomplice (Brian Hutton) to bring the killer to justice. (Movie, Romance, Western) - 1959-10-23

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Kalifornia
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Brian Kessler (David Duchovny) is a writer, and his girlfriend, Carrie Laughlin (Michelle Forbes), is a photographer. They're working on a book about serial killers, and planning a trip across the country to document the sites of famous serial murders. To cut costs, they set up a ride-share with strangers, Early Grayce (Brad Pitt) and his girlfriend, Adele Corners (Juliette Lewis). But what they don't know is that Early is a violent sociopath in the middle of his own serial killing spree. (Crime, Movie, Thriller) - 1993

mgmplusdrivein.us.description: DJay is a pimp living day to day on the tough streets of Memphis, Tennessee. Pushing 40, he's tired of the life he's living and dreams of something greater. When he meets up with an old friend who is now in the recording industry, he's inspired to turn his life around and uses his criminal life as an inspiration to create rap music. When he hears that a rap superstar is coming to town, DJay works a hustle to gain the rapper's attention and hopefully get signed by a label. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Hip-Hop & Rap, Movie) - 2005-07-22

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Blue Chips
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Pete Bell (Nick Nolte) is a college basketball coach who has to improve his team's standing -- by any means necessary. His hopes are pinned on a trio of talented players: Neon Boudeaux (Shaquille O'Neal), Butch McRae (Penny Hardaway) and Ricky Roe (Matt Nover). But in order to get them to sign to his school, Bell will have to illegally pay the players off. If he's caught, it could destroy Bell's coaching career and cast a cloud of shame over his team. Will he risk it all to win? (Drama, Movie) - 1994-02-18

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Coach Carter
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: In 1999, Ken Carter (Samuel L. Jackson) returns to his old high school in Richmond, California, to get the basketball team into shape. With tough rules and academic discipline, he succeeds in setting the players on a winning streak. But when their grades start to suffer, Carter locks them out of the gym and shuts down their championship season. When he is criticized by the players and their parents, he sticks to his guns, determined that they excel in class as well as on the court. (Biography, Drama, History, Movie) - 2005-01-14

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Social Network
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: In 2003, Harvard undergrad and computer genius Mark Zuckerberg (Jesse Eisenberg) begins work on a new concept that eventually turns into the global social network known as Facebook. Six years later, he is one of the youngest billionaires ever, but Zuckerberg finds that his unprecedented success leads to both personal and legal complications when he ends up on the receiving end of two lawsuits, one involving his former friend (Andrew Garfield). Based on the book "The Accidental Billionaires." (Biography, Drama, Movie) - 2010-10-01

mgmplusdrivein.us.description: A teenage hacker finds himself framed for the theft of millions of dollars from a major corporation. Master hacker Dade Murphy, aka Zero Cool, aka Crash Override, has been banned from touching a keyboard for seven years after crashing over 1,500 Wall Street computers at the age of 11. Now keen to get back in front of a monitor, he finds himself in more trouble than ever. (Action, Crime, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1995-09-15

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Blue Chips
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Pete Bell (Nick Nolte) is a college basketball coach who has to improve his team's standing -- by any means necessary. His hopes are pinned on a trio of talented players: Neon Boudeaux (Shaquille O'Neal), Butch McRae (Penny Hardaway) and Ricky Roe (Matt Nover). But in order to get them to sign to his school, Bell will have to illegally pay the players off. If he's caught, it could destroy Bell's coaching career and cast a cloud of shame over his team. Will he risk it all to win? (Drama, Movie) - 1994-02-18

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Four ne'er-do-well sons reunite in their Texas hometown to attend their mother's funeral. Led by older brothers John (John Wayne), a gunfighter, and Tom (Dean Martin), a gambler, the four soon learn that their father gambled away the family ranch, which was the cause of his murder. The brothers decide to avenge their father's death and win back the ranch, a situation that quickly leads to trouble with the local sheriff and violent conflict with the rival Hastings clan. (Movie, Western) - 1965-10-01

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Lifeguard
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Southern California lifeguard Rick Carlson (Sam Elliott) has a real passion for his work, but, when he attends a high school reunion, he begins to feel that his peers have accomplished more than he has. He begins a romance with his former sweetheart, Cathy (Anne Archer), who is now a single mother with a young son. As their relationship progresses, Rick becomes even more confused about his life choices, and he starts to wonder if he should leave the beach behind and become a white-collar man. (Comedy, Drama, Movie) - 1976-07-23

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Back to School
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: Thornton Melon (Rodney Dangerfield) is concerned that his son Jason (Keith Gordon) is unsure whether to go to college, so the uneducated self-made millionaire encourages him by signing up as a student as well. As Jason tries to establish himself among his peers and make the diving team, Thornton falls for a pretty professor (Sally Kellerman) and gets others do his schoolwork for him. When the suspicious dean (Paxton Whitehead) finds out, Thornton needs to show he can get by on his own. (Comedy, Movie) - 1986-06-13

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: Coach Carter
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: In 1999, Ken Carter (Samuel L. Jackson) returns to his old high school in Richmond, California, to get the basketball team into shape. With tough rules and academic discipline, he succeeds in setting the players on a winning streak. But when their grades start to suffer, Carter locks them out of the gym and shuts down their championship season. When he is criticized by the players and their parents, he sticks to his guns, determined that they excel in class as well as on the court. (Biography, Drama, History, Movie) - 2005-01-14

mgmplusdrivein.us.title: The Social Network
mgmplusdrivein.us.description: In 2003, Harvard undergrad and computer genius Mark Zuckerberg (Jesse Eisenberg) begins work on a new concept that eventually turns into the global social network known as Facebook. Six years later, he is one of the youngest billionaires ever, but Zuckerberg finds that his unprecedented success leads to both personal and legal complications when he ends up on the receiving end of two lawsuits, one involving his former friend (Andrew Garfield). (Horror, Science fiction, Comedy) - 2026

mgmplus.us.description: Members of a family find themselves in a desperate fight for survival when a pack of coyotes swarms their Hollywood Hills home. (Horror, Comedy) - 2025

mgmplus.us.title: Midnight Cowboy
mgmplus.us.description: Convinced of his irresistible appeal to women, Texas dishwasher Joe Buck (Jon Voight) quits his job and heads for New York City, thinking he'll latch on to some rich dowager. New York, however, is not as hospitable as he imagined, and Joe soon finds himself living in an abandoned building with a Dickensian layabout named Enrico Ratso Rizzo (Dustin Hoffman). The two form a rough alliance, and together they kick-start Joe's hustling career just as Ratso's health begins to deteriorate. (Drama) - 1969

mgmplus.us.title: Rio Lobo
mgmplus.us.description: Union leader Cord McNally is protecting a routine gold shipment when his troops are attacked by Confederate forces. Not only does he lose the gold, but one of his strongest officers is killed in the raid. At the end of the Civil War, McNally learns that the raiders had help from the inside, and he vows to uncover the two traitors. After a chance encounter with one of the turncoats, McNally travels to the town of Rio Lobo and makes an unexpected discovery. (Western) - 1970

mgmplus.us.title: Vera Cruz
mgmplus.us.description: Following the American Civil War, veteran Benjamin Trane (Gary Cooper) and gunslinger Joe Erin (Burt Lancaster) are just two of many men who head to Mexico as mercenaries. When Emperor Maximilian (George Macready) recruits their services, they reluctantly work together, since the price is right. Trane and Erin are to escort Countess Marie Duvarre (Denise Darcel) to Veracruz -- but when they find a wealth of gold hidden in the stagecoach, the original plan no longer applies. (Western, Adventure, Drama) - 1954

mgmplus.us.title: Betrayed
mgmplus.us.description: Following the murder of a radio personality in Chicago, all evidence of the crime points to a white supremacist group from Iowa. With the FBI on the case, the department sends inexperienced agent Catherine Weaver (Debra Winger) on an undercover mission to root out the killers. Falling for her guise, local farmer and suspect Gary Simmons (Tom Berenger) fully embraces Weaver into the community. As Weaver spends more time with Simmons, her belief in his guilt diminishes and love takes its place. (Thriller) - 1988

mgmplus.us.title: Mystic Pizza
mgmplus.us.description: For sexy Daisy Araujo, her sensible sister Kat and their wisecracking friend Jojo, the summer after high school is a summer they can never forget. Slinging pizza at a local restaurant, the three girls share their hopes, dreams and plans for escaping their small town. (Romantic comedy) - 1988

mgmplus.us.title: Baby Boom
mgmplus.us.description: J.C. Wiatt is a New York City businesswoman who is married to her job and has a relationship with Steven, a successful investment broker. J.C.'s life takes an unexpected turn when a relative suddenly dies and makes her the caretaker of a baby girl. Soon, the baby's arrival causes J.C. to lose first Steven, and then her job. She moves to Vermont and embarks on a series of life-changing events. But when offered the opportunity, will she return to her corporate ways? (Comedy drama, Romance) - 1987

mgmplus.us.title: Overboard
mgmplus.us.description: Kate is a single, working-class mother of three who's hired to clean a luxury yacht that belongs to Leonardo -- a selfish, spoiled and wealthy Mexican playboy. After unjustly firing Kate, Leonardo falls off the boat and wakes up with no memory of who he is. To get payback, Kate shows up at the hospital and convinces the confused amnesiac that they're married. As Leonardo tries to get used to manual labor and his new family, Kate starts to wonder how long she can keep fooling her fake husband. (Romantic comedy) - 2018

mgmplushits.us.title: The Dogs of War
mgmplushits.us.description: Mercenary soldiers Jamie (Christopher Walken) and Drew (Tom Berenger) are hired by a large corporation to liberate Zangaro, a small African nation, from an iron-fisted despot. Once there, Jamie ends up in jail. After being brutally tortured, he is helped by Dr. Okoye (Winston Ntshona), a political prisoner, and learns more about the plight of the country's people. After Jamie is freed, he becomes disillusioned with his wealthy employers and joins the Zangaro people on the revolutionary front. (Action, Drama) - 1980

mgmplushits.us.title: The Social Network
mgmplushits.us.description: In 2003, Harvard undergrad and computer genius Mark Zuckerberg (Jesse Eisenberg) begins work on a new concept that eventually turns into the global social network known as Facebook. Six years later, he is one of the youngest billionaires ever, but Zuckerberg finds that his unprecedented success leads to both personal and legal complications when he ends up on the receiving end of two lawsuits, one involving his former friend (Andrew Garfield). Based on the book "The Accidental Billionaires." (Drama, Biography) - 2010

In an attempt to find out where Banning's loyalties lie, Crown returns the painting and essentially turns himself in, hoping that Banning's feelings for him will lead to an escape. (Thriller, Crime drama, Romance) - 1999

mgmplushits.us.title: Masquerade
mgmplushits.us.description: Olivia Lawrence (Meg Tilly), heiress to her recently deceased mother's sizable fortune, travels in the elite social circles of the Hamptons. Olivia becomes infatuated with Tim Whalen (Rob Lowe), an attractive yacht captain who appears to be uninterested in her money. But the duplicitous Tim -- with help from Olivia's stepfather, Tony Gateworth (John Glover), and childhood friend, Mike McGill (Doug Savant) -- is plotting something sinister against the unwitting heiress. (Crime drama) - 1988

mgmplushits.us.title: Yentl
mgmplushits.us.description: Rebbe Mendel is a single father who teaches the Talmud, a sacred text of Judaism, to the boys of his small Polish town. Behind closed doors, he also instructs his daughter, Yentl, despite the fact that girls are forbidden to study religious scripture. When Yentl's father dies, she still has a strong desire to learn about her faith -- so she disguises herself as a male, enrolls in a religious school, and unexpectedly finds love along the way. (Musical, Drama, Romance) - 1983

mgmplushits.us.title: Hang 'Em High

The lawmen offer him a job as a federal marshal with the caveat that he not abuse his new power to seek revenge against his tormentors. But, when Cooper finds that some of the men who attacked him are involved in another set of crimes, he fights to bring them to justice. (Western) - 1968

mgmplushits.us.title: Everything, Everything
mgmplushits.us.description: Maddy (Amandla Stenberg) is a smart, curious and imaginative 18-year-old who is unable to leave the protection of the hermetically-sealed environment within her house because of an illness. Olly (Nick Robinson) is the boy next door who won't let that stop them from being together. Gazing through windows and talking only through texts, Maddy and Olly form a deep bond that leads them to risk everything to be together, even if it means losing everything. (Romance, Drama) - 2017

mgmplushits.us.title: Every Day
mgmplushits.us.description: Sixteen-year-old Rhiannon falls in love with A, a mysterious spirit who inhabits a different body every day. Feeling an unmatched connection, Rhiannon and A try to find each other on a daily basis, always unsure of what or who the next day will bring. Soon, the realities of loving someone who is a different person every 24 hours starts to take its toll, leaving Rhiannon and A to face the hardest decision either has ever had to make. (Romance, Fantasy, Drama) - 2018

mgmplushits.us.title: The Believers
mgmplushits.us.description: Recently widowed psychiatrist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) has just moved back to New York City with his young son, Chris (Harley Cross), in an attempt to start over after his wife's horrific accidental death. Cal takes an assignment helping the police with the investigation of a cult-like and bizarre ritualistic double murder. As Cal gets closer to the truth, he realizes that he and those close to him may be the target of supernatural and deadly forces, and that the enemy is closer than he knows. (Horror, Crime drama) - 1987

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Tommy Boy
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: After his beloved father (Brian Dennehy) dies, dim-witted Tommy Callahan (Chris Farley) inherits a near-bankrupt automobile parts factory in Sandusky, Ohio. His brand-new stepmother, Beverly (Bo Derek), wants to cash out and close, but Tommy's sentimental attachment to his father's employees spurs him to make one last-ditch effort to find someone who will buy their products. With his father's tightly wound assistant, Richard (David Spade), in tow, Tommy hits the road to scare up some new clients. (Comedy, Adventure) - 1995

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: A Night at the Roxbury
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Despite being well into adulthood, brothers Doug and Steve Butabi still live at home and work in the flower shop owned by their dad. They exist only to hit on women at discos, though they're routinely unsuccessful until a chance run-in with Richard Grieco gets them inside the swank Roxbury club. Mistaken for high rollers, they meet their dream women, Vivica and Cambi, and resolve to open a club of their own. (Comedy) - 1998

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Failure to Launch
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life. (Romantic comedy) - 2001

showtime.us.title: Hotel Transylvania 2

showtime.us.title: The Dutchman

showtime2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
showtime2west.us.description: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

showtime2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
showtime2west.us.description: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

showtime2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
showtime2west.us.description: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

showtime2west.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
showtime2west.us.description: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett).

showtime2west.us.title: Noah
showtime2west.us.description: God chooses Noah (Russell Crowe) to build an ark and save the animals and his family from an apocalyptic flood.

showtime2west.us.title: Troy
showtime2west.us.description: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy.

showtime2west.us.title: Se7en
showtime2west.us.description: A meticulous detective and the young officer about to replace the veteran probe serial murders based on the seven deadly sins.

showtime2west.us.title: The Dark Tower
showtime2west.us.description: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, must prevent the Man in Black (Matthew McConaughey) from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together.

showtime2west.us.title: Patriot Games
showtime2west.us.description: An IRA terrorist vows revenge against the ex-CIA agent who killed the man's brother and thwarted an attack on royalty.

showtime2west.us.title: Confess, Fletch
showtime2west.us.description: While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend.

showtime2west.us.title: Hotel Transylvania
showtime2west.us.description: Dracula becomes overprotective when a human boy discovers his monsters-only resort during a birthday celebration and falls for his teenage daughter.

showtime2west.us.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
showtime2west.us.description: Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula and his friends put the boy through a "monster-in-training" boot camp just as Drac's old-school father decides to pay a visit.

showtime2west.us.title: A Night at the Roxbury
showtime2west.us.description: Desperate to meet women and open their own dance club, brainless brothers Steve (Will Ferrell) and Doug Butabi (Chris Kattan) cruise Beverly Hills.

showtime2west.us.title: Daddy's Home
showtime2west.us.description: An insecure man (Will Ferrell) competes for the affection of his stepchildren when their freewheeling father (Mark Wahlberg) breezes back into town.

showtime2west.us.title: Rush Hour
showtime2west.us.description: A Hong Kong detective and a wisecracking L.A.P.D. detective choose to work together to find the missing daughter of a Chinese diplomat.

showtime2west.us.title: Rush Hour 2
showtime2west.us.description: Two detectives (Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker) battle a Hong Kong gangster (John Lone) and his henchmen after a bombing at the U.S. Embassy.

showtime2west.us.title: Rush Hour 3
showtime2west.us.description: The assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord.

showtime2west.us.title: She's Out of My League
showtime2west.us.description: An airport security agent must figure out how to make the relationship work when a beautiful, successful woman falls in love with him.

showtime2west.us.title: Horrible Bosses
showtime2west.us.description: Three oppressed workers (Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis) devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their intolerable employers.

showtime2west.us.title: Horrible Bosses 2
showtime2west.us.description: After a shady investor steals their new invention, Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) conspire to kidnap the man's adult son and ransom him to pay off their debts.

showtime2west.us.title: Piranha
showtime2west.us.description: Spring break turns gory at a popular waterside resort, where hundreds of prehistoric man-eating fish have come to dine on hapless humans.

showtime2west.us.title: V for Vendetta
showtime2west.us.description: After world war leads to a fascist government, a vigilante known as V (Hugo Weaving) uses terrorist tactics to fight the totalitarian state in which he now lives.

showtime2west.us.title: Hostage
showtime2west.us.description: A former hostage negotiator (Bruce Willis) must take action when three carjackers hold a wealthy man (Kevin Pollak) and his children at gunpoint.

showtime2west.us.title: I Was a Stranger
showtime2west.us.description: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries.

showtime2west.us.title: Paranormal Activity
showtime2west.us.description: A young couple (Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat) move into their first new home but are disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence that is most active at night.

showtime2west.us.title: House at the End of the Street
showtime2west.us.description: A divorcee (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter (Jennifer Lawrence) learn that they have moved next door to a house in which a girl killed her parents, then disappeared, leaving a brother (Max Thieriot) as the only survivor.

showtime2west.us.title: Molly's Game
showtime2west.us.description: Molly Bloom runs the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested by the FBI. Her only ally is defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learns that there is much more to Molly than the tabloids lead people to believe.

showtimefamily.us.title: Galaxy Quest
showtimefamily.us.description: Aliens, believing actors to be real heroes, enlist cast members of a sci-fi TV series to help save their people.

showtimefamily.us.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
showtimefamily.us.description: A renegade Vulcan makes Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise go to a planet at the center of the galaxy.

showtimefamily.us.title: Where the Wild Things Are
showtimefamily.us.description: Sent to bed without supper, a mischievous boy enters a land that grows out of his imagination and becomes king of the fantastic creatures who live there.

showtimefamily.us.title: Hotel Transylvania
showtimefamily.us.description: Dracula becomes overprotective when a human boy discovers his monsters-only resort during a birthday celebration and falls for his teenage daughter.

showtimefamily.us.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
showtimefamily.us.description: Concerned that his half-human grandson isn't showing his vampire side, Dracula and his friends put the boy through a "monster-in-training" boot camp just as Drac's old-school father decides to pay a visit.

showtimefamily.us.title: Free Birds
showtimefamily.us.description: Two turkeys (Owen Wilson, Woody Harrelson) travel back in time to the year 1621 to prevent all feathered friends from ever becoming holiday dinners.

showtimefamily.us.title: Best in Show
showtimefamily.us.description: Pampered pooches and their quirky owners converge on Philadelphia to compete in a prestigious dog show.

showtimefamily.us.title: Coneheads
showtimefamily.us.description: Stranded on Earth, aliens Beldar and Prymaat of Remulak try suburbia with their teenage daughter, Connie.

showtimefamily.us.title: Turtle Power: The Definitive History of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
showtimefamily.us.description: The release of Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird's groundbreaking comic in 1984 leads to a worldwide phenomenon.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Kid
showtimefamily.us.description: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents.

showtimefamily.us.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
showtimefamily.us.description: Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy), McCoy (DeForest Kelley) and the Enterprise encounter sabotage on the way to peace talks with the Klingon Federation.

showtimefamily.us.title: Good Burger
showtimefamily.us.description: Teen misfits (Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson) at a modest burger joint face competition from a hamburger emporium across the street.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Addams Family
showtimefamily.us.description: When a man claiming to be Fester, the missing brother of Gomez Addams, arrives at the Addams' home, the family is thrilled. Morticia begins to suspect the man is a fraud, since he cannot recall details of Fester's life.

showtimefamily.us.title: Yours, Mine & Ours
showtimefamily.us.description: A household threatens to burst at the seams when the marriage of two widowed parents creates a family of 18 children.

showtimefamily.us.title: Star Trek: First Contact
showtimefamily.us.description: Picard (Patrick Stewart), Riker (Jonathan Frakes) and the others set off to stop the half-robot Borg from sabotaging the first warp drive flight in 2063.

showtimefamily.us.title: Stardust
showtimefamily.us.description: To win the heart of his beloved, a young man (Charlie Cox) ventures into the realm of fairies to retrieve a fallen star (Claire Danes).

showtimefamily.us.title: Mr. Holmes
showtimefamily.us.description: Long-retired and near the end of his life, Sherlock Holmes (Ian McKellen) grapples with an unreliable memory and must rely on his housekeeper's son as he revisits the still-unsolved case that led to his retirement.

showtimefamily.us.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
showtimefamily.us.description: Kirk (William Shatner), Spock (Leonard Nimoy) and the Enterprise crew battle an old foe (Ricardo Montalban) who blames Kirk for the death of his wife.

showtimefamily.us.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
showtimefamily.us.description: Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew steal the old Enterprise and head for Vulcan to reunite the mind and body of Mr. Spock.

showtimefamily.us.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
showtimefamily.us.description: Spock (Leonard Nimoy), Kirk (William Shatner) and the Enterprise time-travel to modern-day San Francisco to bring humpback whales to the 23rd century.

showtimefamily.us.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
showtimefamily.us.description: In the future a cutting-edge android in the form of a boy (Haley Joel Osment) embarks on a journey to discover his true nature.

showtimefamily.us.title: Bran Nue Dae
showtimefamily.us.description: A rebellious young man runs away from home but returns after experiencing an amazing journey.

showtimefamily.us.title: Rugrats Go Wild
showtimefamily.us.description: The toddlers meet the Thornberry family after an accident leaves them stranded on a tropical island.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Rugrats Movie
showtimefamily.us.description: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
showtimefamily.us.description: Siblings (Freddie Highmore, Sarah Bolger) learn that magical creatures are behind the strange occurrences at their great-great-uncle's rundown estate.

showtimefamily.us.title: Love Means Zero
showtimefamily.us.description: Tennis coach Nick Bollettieri's relentless desire to win at all costs leads to the destruction of an important relationship.

showtimefamily.us.title: A Wonderful Time of the Year
showtimefamily.us.description: The Marsh family's getting together for their first Christmas Eve after three years of pandemic lockdown.

showtimefamily.us.title: The Monster Squad
showtimefamily.us.description: Members (Andre Gower, Robby Kiger) of a monster fan club meet Count Dracula, Wolfman, Frankenstein, the Mummy and Gill Man.

screenpixaction.us.title: Born Losers
screenpixaction.us.description: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy. (Crime drama) - 1967

screenpixaction.us.title: Cycle Savages
screenpixaction.us.description: A biker (Bruce Dern) and his gang go after an artist (Chris Robinson) for whom his girlfriend posed in the nude. (Adventure) - 1970

screenpixaction.us.title: Hannibal Brooks
screenpixaction.us.description: A British prisoner of war is assigned to take care of an elephant in a zoo. Along with an American and an Austrian he escapes with the elephant and heads for the Swiss border. They use the elephant to gain access across the border. A Polish girl betrays them and aligns herself with the Nazis. (Comedy drama, War) - 1969

screenpixaction.us.title: Night Fighters
screenpixaction.us.description: An Irish rebel (Robert Mitchum) blows the whistle on Nazi collaborators in the Irish Republican Army. (War) - 1960

screenpixaction.us.title: Ambush Bay
screenpixaction.us.description: In 1944, Sgt. Steve Corey (Hugh O'Brian) leads a group of U.S. Marines on a covert mission to an island in the Philippines that is occupied by Japanese forces. There, the soldiers learn that the enemy has planted a series of mines to destroy General MacArthur's incoming troops, who are preparing to storm the island. Before the Marines get a chance to relay the information, they suffer a deadly attack, leaving only the valiant Corey and Pfc. James Grenier (James Mitchum) to save the day. (War) - 1966

screenpixaction.us.title: The Secret Invasion
screenpixaction.us.description: When the Allies need expendable soldiers for a highly dangerous mission, they offer pardons to a group of criminals in exchange for their participation. Led by the brooding Maj. Richard Mace (Stewart Granger), the motley crew, including explosives expert Terence Scanlon (Mickey Rooney) and scheming tough guy Roberto Rocca (Raf Vallone), sets out to extract a defecting Italian general held captive in a Nazi-controlled area. As they get farther into German territory, the casualties start to rise. (War) - 1964

screenpixaction.us.title: Tank Battalion
screenpixaction.us.description: During the Korean War, Sgt. Brad Dunne (Don Kelly) heads a tank battalion consisting of reluctant young recruit Pfc. Danny Collins (Bob Padget) and seasoned soldiers Corp. Corbett (Edward G. Robinson Jr.) and Pfc. Madigan (Frank Gorshin). When guerrillas launch a series of ambushes on a U.S. base camp, Dunne and his men are ordered to lead an offensive against the rebels. But, just as they approach the front lines, a grenade blast disables their tank, stranding them as the enemy approaches. (War) - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: Kill a Dragon
screenpixaction.us.description: When a valuable shipment of nitroglycerin washes ashore on an island near Hong Kong, the natives think it's theirs, owing to the law of salvage. However, local mob boss Nico Patrai thinks otherwise and gives the islanders three days to return it before he starts killing them. Rather than give in, the islanders hire soldier of fortune Rick Masters to help them smuggle the shipment off the island and sell it in Hong Kong. (Action) - 1967

screenpixaction.us.title: Top of the World
screenpixaction.us.description: A jet pilot finds himself assigned to the barren wastes of Alaska where it becomes his duty to man an observation post. (Adventure) - 1955

screenpixaction.us.title: The Gallant Hours
screenpixaction.us.description: As he retires from the U.S. Navy, Admiral William J. Halsey (James Cagney) recalls the most daunting challenge in his career: the Battle of Guadalcanal in 1942. Ordered to replace a close friend as fleet admiral, Halsey faces a wily and fierce adversary in Japan's Admiral Yamamoto, and spends the grueling months of the campaign confounding expectations of both the enemy and his own staff. Pained by the losses he knows they will endure, Halsey pushes his forces to the brink. (Biography) - 1960

screenpixaction.us.title: One Man's Hero
screenpixaction.us.description: In 1848, Jon Riley heads a group of Irish-born Roman Catholic soldiers in the U.S. Army. The group faces religious prejudice in the predominantly Protestant military. In the midst of the war against Mexico, Riley and some of his fellow soldiers go to a Catholic Church and are cruelly punished as a result. Because of this, they defect to the Mexican Army, where they meet guerrilla leader Cortina, with whom they forge an unlikely bond. (Drama) - 1999

screenpixaction.us.title: Night Fighters
screenpixaction.us.description: An Irish rebel (Robert Mitchum) blows the whistle on Nazi collaborators in the Irish Republican Army. (War) - 1960

screenpixaction.us.title: Ambush Bay
screenpixaction.us.description: In 1944, Sgt. Steve Corey (Hugh O'Brian) leads a group of U.S. Marines on a covert mission to an island in the Philippines that is occupied by Japanese forces. There, the soldiers learn that the enemy has planted a series of mines to destroy General MacArthur's incoming troops, who are preparing to storm the island. Before the Marines get a chance to relay the information, they suffer a deadly attack, leaving only the valiant Corey and Pfc. James Grenier (James Mitchum) to save the day. (War) - 1966

screenpix.us.title: Toys in the Attic
screenpix.us.description: Black sheep Julian Berniers (Dean Martin) returns home -- along with wife Lily (Yvette Mimieux) -- to his two sisters in New Orleans. Julian's shoe factory in Illinois has gone bankrupt, but he tells them he saved enough money to be comfortable. Julian's sister, Carrie (Geraldine Page), nurses a borderline incestuous affection for Julian and dislikes Lily. When Carrie overhears Julian revealing his money was swindled from Cyrus Warkins (Larry Gates), she convinces naive Lily to betray Julian. (Drama) - 1963

screenpix.us.title: Mystery of the 13th Guest
screenpix.us.description: A young woman opens her grandfather's will when she turns 21, and someone starts murdering the heirs. (Mystery) - 1943

screenpix.us.title: Hit and Run
screenpix.us.description: An old junk dealer's (Hugo Haas) chorus-girl bride (Cleo Moore) and helper (Vince Edwards) run into his twin brother. (Crime drama) - 1957

screenpix.us.title: The Masque of the Red Death
screenpix.us.description: A tyrannical 12th-century prince is intrigued by a girl and takes her to live amid the immorality of his court. (Horror) - 1964

screenpix.us.title: The Secret of NIMH 2: Timmy to the Rescue
screenpix.us.description: In this animated film, after recovering from an illness that plagued him in his youth, country mouse Timmy Brisby (Ralph Macchio) grows into a strong young rodent. And when fellow Thorn Valley resident Jenny McBride (Hynden Walsh) begs him to find her missing mother and father, he gets the opportunity to prove himself worthy of the Brisby name. Timmy sets out on a journey that puts him on a collision course with wicked mouse Martin (Eric Idle) and the dreaded National Institute of Mental Health. (Animated, Children, Adventure) - 1998

screenpix.us.title: Sea Fury
screenpix.us.description: The first mate (Stanley Baker) of a British salvage boat rivals his captain (Victor McLaglen) for a Spanish girl (Luciana Paluzzi). (Adventure, Action, Drama) - 1958

screenpix.us.title: Operation Bikini
screenpix.us.description: During World War II, a U.S. submarine under the command of Capt. Emmett Carey (Scott Brady) takes on the underwater demolition team of Lt. Morgan Hayes (Tab Hunter) -- which includes Seaman Joseph Malzone (Frankie Avalon) -- when the radar equipment of a sunken ship needs to be destroyed. Reaching their target at Bikini Atoll, they find the area full of hostile enemies and helpful guerrillas, including the stunning Reiko (Eva Six), with whom Hayes develops a relationship during the mission. (War) - 1963

screenpix.us.title: Electra
screenpix.us.description: When King Agamemnon returns from battle, he is slain by his wife, Clytemnestra (Aleka Katselli), and her lover. The king's son, Orestis (Giannis Fertis), is sent into exile, and his daughter, Electra (Irene Papas), into mourning. Over the years, Electra's hatred of her mother grows, and she bristles with the desire for vengeance. When she and Orestis are reunited, the siblings hatch a plot for revenge. But can they reconcile their need for justice with the act of matricide? (Drama) - 1962

screenpix.us.title: Eight on the Lam
screenpix.us.description: A widower with seven children, Henry Dimsdale (Bob Hope) is employed as a bank teller. After finding $10,000 on the street, Henry takes the money home, but quickly finds out that the cash came from his workplace. Soon Henry is on the run with his kids, while their babysitter, Golda (Phyllis Diller), tries to throw her none-too-bright police officer boyfriend, Jasper Lynch (Jonathan Winters), off their trail. Amid the antics, Henry falls for pretty schoolteacher Ellie Barton (Shirley Eaton). (Comedy) - 1967

screenpix.us.title: High Spirits
screenpix.us.description: Irish hotelier Peter Plunkett attempts to fill the chronic vacancies at his castle by launching an advertising campaign that wrongly portrays the property as haunted. Unfortunately, he fails to scare a single American tourist with his hokey and dreadfully unconvincing effects. When two actual ghosts, Mary and Martin, show up to add some authenticity, they end up falling for two guests, Sharon and Jack. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1988

screenpix.us.title: The Killer Elite
screenpix.us.description: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. But, when George gets a better offer from the competition, he turns on Mike, breaking his elbow and shoulder. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate. (Action) - 1975

screenpix.us.title: Little Norse Prince Valiant
screenpix.us.description: A Norwegian prince fights evil with a rock man's sword of the sun. (Animated, Children, Fantasy, Adventure) - 1969

screenpix.us.title: The Purple Plain
screenpix.us.description: At the end of World War II in Burma, Canadian Royal Air Force pilot Forrester (Gregory Peck) is a loner whose bravery can't cover a streak of reckless instability. When his actions cause an injury, he is nearly transferred, but Dr. Harris (Bernard Lee) recommends pulling him from duty, due to the emotional trauma he's suffered. Forrester then accompanies Harris to a Christian missionary outpost, where he meets Anna (Win Min Than) and begins to find interest in living again. (Adventure, Action) - 1954

screenpix.us.title: The Secret of NIMH 2: Timmy to the Rescue
screenpix.us.description: In this animated film, after recovering from an illness that plagued him in his youth, country mouse Timmy Brisby (Ralph Macchio) grows into a strong young rodent. And when fellow Thorn Valley resident Jenny McBride (Hynden Walsh) begs him to find her missing mother and father, he gets the opportunity to prove himself worthy of the Brisby name. screenpix.us.title: Sea Fury
screenpix.us.description: The first mate (Stanley Baker) of a British salvage boat rivals his captain (Victor McLaglen) for a Spanish girl (Luciana Paluzzi). (Adventure, Action, Drama) - 1958

screenpixvoices.us.title: Crack House
screenpixvoices.us.description: Rick (Gregg Thomsen) and Melissa (Cheryl Kay) are two young lovebirds struggling against the crime and poverty of the Los Angeles ghetto they inhabit. Their hopes of ever leaving are destroyed when one of Rick's relatives is killed in a drive-by shooting. Seeking to avenge the vicious murder, Rick rejoins his former gang, but gets himself arrested. During his absence, Melissa becomes involved with drug dealers and is addicted to crack. Rick then sets out on a difficult mission to save her. (Crime drama) - 1989

screenpixvoices.us.title: Original Gangstas
screenpixvoices.us.description: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence. (Action) - 1996

screenpixvoices.us.title: Soda Cracker
screenpixvoices.us.description: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner. (Crime drama) - 1989

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Wild Pair
screenpixvoices.us.description: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists. (Action) - 1987

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hollywood Shuffle
screenpixvoices.us.description: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson). (Comedy) - 1987

screenpixvoices.us.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
screenpixvoices.us.description: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing. (Comedy drama) - 1970

screenpixvoices.us.title: Census Taker
screenpixvoices.us.description: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective. (Comedy) - 1984

screenpixvoices.us.title: Blind Rage
screenpixvoices.us.description: A CIA agent (Fred Williamson) in a pancake house closes the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines. (Action, Comedy) - 1978

screenpixvoices.us.title: Carbon Copy
screenpixvoices.us.description: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot. (Comedy) - 1981

screenpixvoices.us.title: Body and Soul
screenpixvoices.us.description: Leon Johnson (Leon Isaac Kennedy) is a boxer who plans to study medicine, but, with his ailing sister, Kelly (Nikki Swassy), in need of costly care, he decides to earn a living in the ring. His rise is rapid, but Leon's newly extravagant lifestyle threatens his relationship with girlfriend Julie (Jayne Kennedy). As Leon approaches the sport's highest echelons, he faces increasingly tough decisions that test his loyalty to his family and himself. (Drama) - 1981

screenpixvoices.us.title: Hammer
screenpixvoices.us.description: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on. (Crime drama, Action) - 1972

screenpixvoices.us.title: Penitentiary
screenpixvoices.us.description: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release. (Drama) - 1979

screenpixvoices.us.title: Penitentiary II
screenpixvoices.us.description: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead. (Action) - 1982

screenpixvoices.us.title: Diggstown
screenpixvoices.us.description: After being released from a Georgia prison, smooth-talking con man Gabriel Caine (James Woods) teams up with his partner in crime, Fitz (Oliver Platt), and travels to remote Diggstown. Upon arriving, Fitz and Caine bet the wealthiest resident, former boxing manager John Gillon (Bruce Dern), that they know a guy who can beat Diggstown's 10 best fighters in one day. After Caine reels in "Honey" Roy Palmer (Louis Gossett Jr.), an aging boxer and old acquaintance, the grift is on. (Action) - 1992

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Small Soldiers
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A toy company develops action-figure soldiers whose realistic fighting capabilities cause mayhem for a toy-shop owner and his family. Unaware of their military prowess, the shopkeeper takes delivery of the soldiers, who break free from their packaging to attack their Gorgonite enemies. When the Gorgonites communicate with the shopkeeper's son, the humans find themselves under siege.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The BFG
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A 10-year-old girl, Queen Elizabeth II and the Big Friendly Giant must devise a plan to get rid of Bloodbottler, Fleshlumpeater and all the other bad giants once and for all.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Goosebumps
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young kid teams up with the niece of young adult horror author RL Stine after the writer's imaginary demons are set free on the town of Greendale, Maryland.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Goosebumps 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Best friends meet, a mischievous dummy who brings his ghoulish friends back to life, just in time for Halloween. As the town becomes overrun with monsters, the boys join forces to save the town from Slappy's wicked plan.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Three singing chipmunks are happily residing in a lovely tree until their green home gets chopped down and taken to be the Christmas tree in the reception of an LA record company. There, they buddy up with failing songwriter Dave, who realises the talented critters have got the potential for big musical success. When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Stuart Little
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A New York couple go to an orphanage to adopt a brother for their only son, but instead come away with a little mouse. On arrival at his new home, the diminutive rodent receives a lukewarm welcome by the boy - and an even frostier reception from the pet cat. Featuring a mixture of live action and animation.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Stuart Little 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Sequel to the children's story about the adventures of a small mouse, blending live action and computer-animated characters. The eponymous hero befriends a tiny bird wounded by a sinister falcon, but he must enlist the help of the dreaded family cat if he is to protect his new-found friend.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Karate Kid Part II
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Old rivalries and new adversaries await Daniel and Mr Miyagi as they travel to Okinawa to visit Miyagi's ailing father.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Karate Kid Part III
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A boy trained in the martial arts is alienated from his mentor just when he needs to prepare for a showdown with his arch-enemy. Instead, he turns to a Vietnam vet who teaches him how to fight dirty - a strategy the youth comes to realise is a mistake.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Karate Kid
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After moving to China, a twelve-year-old boy falls in love with one of his classmates. This soon comes to the attention of the class bully.

skycinemafamily.uk.description: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

skycinemafamily.uk.description: A martial arts master has an uphill battle on his hands when he takes in a troubled girl as his latest apprentice.

skycinemafamily.uk.description: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young farmhand gets swept into the realm of legend when he must defend his land from a seemingly unstoppable force of giant warriors.

When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?

skycinemafamily.uk.description: With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Addams Family
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The lives of Gomez and Morticia Addams are thrown into disarray when a scheming siren attempts to pass off her son as Gomez's long-lost brother Fester. Once installed in the family's spooky mansion, mother and son set their minds on stealing the family fortune.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. Their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian.

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Raintree County
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Southern belle Susanna Drake (Elizabeth Taylor) visits Indiana, she falls for John Wickliff Shawnessy (Montgomery Clift), an abolitionist with strong ideals. However, John falters while he lets Drake tempt him away from his true love, Nell Gaither (Eva Marie Saint). After Drake deceives John into marriage, the two move to her New Orleans household, where he discovers that mental illness runs in her family. When the Civil War begins, John uses it to escape from the unhappy marriage. (Drama) - 1957

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: All Fall Down
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Ralph Willart (Karl Malden) and his wife Annabell (Angela Lansbury) are constantly at odds over what to do with their son, Berry-Berry (Warren Beatty). While Annabell treats him like a saint, Ralph is more keen on his boy's womanizing ways. Berry-Berry's younger brother Clint (Brandon de Wilde) idolizes him despite what his father says, but when Berry-Berry develops a relationship with family friend Echo O'Brien (Eva Marie Saint), Clint discovers just how shallow his older brother is. (Drama) - 1962

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: 36 Hours
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In occupied Germany in 1949, American military officer Jefferson Pike (James Garner) wakes up in a U.S. Army hospital with no memory of the previous five years. A kindly military psychiatrist (Rod Taylor) and his coolly detached nurse (Eva Marie Saint) draw out Pike's last clear memories, which are of General Eisenhower's final briefing for the Normandy invasion in June 1944. Soon, Pike realizes that his doctor and nurse are not who they claim to be, and that he is in great danger. (Thriller) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Airport 1975
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When an in-flight collision incapacitates the pilots of an airplane bound for Los Angeles, stewardess Nancy Pryor (Karen Black) is forced to take over the controls. From the ground, her boyfriend Alan Murdock (Charlton Heston), a retired test pilot, tries to talk her through piloting and landing the 747 aircraft. Worse yet, the anxious passengers -- among which are a noisy nun (Helen Reddy) and a cranky man (Sid Caesar) -- are aggravating the already tense atmosphere. (Thriller) - 1974

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Lonelyhearts
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Burdened by a family secret, Adam White (Montgomery Clift) lands a job as a newspaper advice columnist. Little does he realize that it's all part of a nasty desire by cynical editor William Shrike (Robert Ryan) to crush the souls of his underlings. Adam feels his readers' pain, and eventually he takes an assignment to meet with Fay Doyle (Maureen Stapleton), who is exasperated by her crippled husband. When Fay tries to seduce Adam, he must choose between his job and his girl (Dolores Hart). (Drama) - 1958

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Ambassador's Daughter
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Senator Cartwright (Adolphe Menjou) and his wife (Myrna Loy) arrive in Paris as the guests of Ambassador Fiske (Edward Arnold). Cartwright has a plan to restrict the city from American soldiers on leave due to their boorish behavior. Fiske's daughter, Joan (Olivia de Havilland), tries to prove that Cartwright is wrong about the soldiers by going on a date with one named Danny (John Forsythe). Although Joan does not reveal her plan, Danny acts like a gentleman, and she starts to fall for him. (Comedy) - 1956

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Man in Possession

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Lord Jeff

Once apprehended, Geoff is sent to a mariner's academy run by kindly headmaster Capt. Briggs (Charles Coburn) that houses orphaned boys. Geoff resists the school's discipline and runs away, but school leader Terry O'Mulvaney (Mickey Rooney) brings him back, then refuses to tell on him -- prompting Geoff to reconsider his attitude. (Drama) - 1938

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Our Town
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: For the residents of Grover's Corners, daily life proceeds at a predictable pace. The milkman (Stuart Erwin) arrives like clockwork, the neighbors perpetually gossip about nothing and children contemplate their future. Two of these children, George (William Holden) and Emily (Martha Scott), fall in love as adults and, despite last-minute nerves, get married. Their happiness does not last, however, as Emily dies during the birth of a child. Returning as a ghost, she ponders her existence. (Drama) - 1940

themoviechannel.us.title: Fist Fight

Things go from bad to worse when he crosses Ron Strickland, the school's toughest and most feared teacher. When Strickland gets fired, he challenges Campbell to a fight after school. As news of the showdown spreads like wildfire, poor Andy desperately seeks any way out of his date with certain doom. (Comedy) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: The Firm

The company is helping to launder mob money, get clients off charges and even murder partners who threaten to blow their cover, but when the FBI come calling to gather evidence on the lawyer's colleagues, he is caught between a rock and a hard place, juggling his life and his liberty. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1993

themoviechannel.us.title: Days of Thunder

When both of them are seriously injured in competition, the former bitter rivals become close friends. With Cole's spirits restored by a romance with neurosurgeon Dr. Claire Lewicki (Nicole Kidman), and Rowdy still sidelined by injuries, Cole decides to race Rowdy's car in the Daytona 500 against underhanded newcomer Russ Wheeler (Cary Elwes). (Action, Drama, Romance) - 1990

themoviechannel.us.title: The Core

With the planet's magnetic field rapidly deteriorating, our atmosphere literally starts to come apart at the seams with catastrophic consequences. To resolve the crisis, Keyes, along with a team of the world's most gifted scientists, travel into the Earth's core. Their mission: detonate a device that will reactivate the core. (Action, Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller, Drama) - 2003

themoviechannel.us.title: Below

Richard Brice (Bruce Greenwood) is determined to steer his disheartened crew back to safety. But after three battle survivors board the sub, bizarre and frightening things begin to happen. As the tale unfolds, and crew members begin to disappear, Ensign Douglas O'Dell (Matthew Davis) must piece together the puzzles of the submarine's past before it is too late to resurface alive. (Thriller) - 2002

themoviechannel.us.title: Escape From Alcatraz

Morris quickly realizes the prison's dehumanizing effects and clashes with its cruel warden (Patrick McGoohan). Fed up with life at Alcatraz, Morris and two convict brothers (Fred Ward, Jack Thibeau) meticulously plan the unthinkable: an escape from the island. (Thriller, Action, Historical drama) - 1979

themoviechannel.us.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life

According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2003

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E7 Invasion of the Dinosaurs: Part 3 The Doctor has captured a Tyrannosaurus Rex but the conspirators don’t intend for it to remain captive for long. Sarah follows a lead but places herself in the hands of the enemy.

BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E8 Invasion of the Dinosaurs: Part 4 Sarah awakens to discover that she is on a spaceship that left Earth months ago and is heading for a new world. The Doctor is framed for causing the return of the dinosaurs.

BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E10 Invasion of the Dinosaurs: Part 6 Dinosaurs are appearing all over London in a last effort to frighten people away as Professor Whitaker prepares to initiated ‘Operation Golden Age’.

BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E11 Death to the Daleks: Part 1 The TARDIS suffers a power drain and is forced down on the planet Exxilon. Sarah is captured by the primitive inhabitants and the Doctor comes face to face with his oldest enemies.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E12 Death to the Daleks: Part 2 The Daleks weaponry is rendered useless by the power drain and they are forced to make a truce with the Doctor and the members of the expedition from Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E13 Death to the Daleks: Part 3 The Daleks force the Exillons to work as slave labour to mine the life saving parrinium. The Doctor and Bellal brave the puzzles and traps of the Exxilon city.

BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E20 The Monster of Peladon: Part 6 The Doctor and the miners take the upper hand in the fight to reclaim Peladon from the Ice Warriors. But Eckersley is unwilling to give up and takes Queen Thalira hostage.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E21 Planet of the Spiders: Part 1 The Doctor receives a mysterious package from his old companion, Jo Grant. Sarah joins Mike Yates to investigate sinister events at a Buddhist meditation centre.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E22 Planet of the Spiders: Part 2 Lupton, now under the control of a giant spider, infiltrates UNIT HQ and steals the Metebelis crystal. But the Doctor is unwilling to give it up so easily and a chase begins.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E23 Planet of the Spiders: Part 3 Following Lupton, Sarah is transported to Metebelis 3 where she is captured by the human villagers. The Doctor uses the TARDIS to follow Sarah, but the spiders are waiting.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E24 Planet of the Spiders: Part 4 With the Doctor in a coma, his only hope of survival lies with a device inside the TARDIS. Sarah is captured by the spiders and is held prisoner in their larder.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E25 Planet of the Spiders: Part 5 Sarah makes a bargain with the Queen Spider and returns to Earth with the Doctor in the TARDIS. There they meet K’anpo, the Doctor’s Time Lord guru who has the Metebelis crystal.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S11 E26 Planet of the Spiders: Part 6 The Doctor takes the blue crystal and returns to Metebelis 3 where he must face the spider ruler, the Great One. But it is an encounter that he may not survive.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E1 Robot: Part 1 UNIT are called in when top secret plans and valuable equipment is stolen from high security establishments. The newly regenerated Doctor suggests that the thief may not be human.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E2 Robot: Part 2 Using the deadly disintegrator weapon, the robot steals the destructor codes. Harry Sullivan is sent to infiltrate Think Tank to discover the truth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E3 Robot: Part 3 Sealed inside an underground bunker, Miss Winters issues her demands to the world’s leaders, threatening a devastating nuclear strike if her demands are not met.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E4 Robot: Part 4 The Doctor races to avert a nuclear holocaust. The robot, distraught over killing its creator, takes Sarah hostage and goes on a rampage.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E5 The Ark in Space: Part 1 The TARDIS arrives in the far future on the Ark space station where the survivors of mankind are in hibernation. Sarah is accidentally placed in suspended animation.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E6 The Ark in Space: Part 2 When the Doctor restores the power to the Ark, the humans begin to revive. But the station has been invaded by the giant insectoid Wirrn.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E7 The Ark in Space: Part 3 The Doctor subjects himself to a dangerous experiment so that he can access the memories of the dead Wirrn Queen. Elsewhere, the larvae Wirrn are pupating into their adult form.
