BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E9 The Sontaran Experiment: Part 1 The Doctor, Harry and Sarah find Earth is an empty wilderness. They meet a group of stranded human colonists who are being hunted by a robot and experimented upon by its master.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E10 The Sontaran Experiment: Part 2 Sarah has been captured by the Sontaran, Field Major Styre who is conducting cruel experiments on the captured humans, paving the way for a full-scale invasion.

BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E11 Genesis of the Daleks: Part 1 The Time Lords send the Doctor, Sarah and Harry to Skaro at a point in time shortly before the creation of the Daleks. The Doctor's mission is to destroy his greatest enemy.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E12 Genesis of the Daleks: Part 2 The Doctor finds that some of Davros’s fellow Kaleds are unhappy with the development of the Daleks. Sarah is forced to load a Thal war rocket with radioactive explosives.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E13 Genesis of the Daleks: Part 3 The Doctor informs the Kaled government of Davros’s experiments and they move to shut down the bunker. But Davros is one step ahead and prepares to take drastic action.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E14 Genesis of the Daleks: Part 4 When the Kaled dome is destroyed by the Thals’ rocket, the war appears to be over and the Thals rejoice at their victory. But then, the Daleks appear and a massacre begins.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E15 Genesis of the Daleks: Part 5 With Harry and Sarah his prisoners, Davros interrogates the Doctor, forcing him to reveal the future of the Daleks so that he can learn from their defeats to make them stronger.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S12 E16 Genesis of the Daleks: Part 6 The Kaled scientific elite move to prevent the development of the Daleks while the Doctor prepares to destroy them forever. But is it already too late?

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie Cooks Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Basilicata This week Jamie heads off the beaten track to the breath-taking but little known Basilicata in search of some seriously old school Italian recipes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Black Sesame Tangyuan All the best moments and bits from Destination Flavour China, led by famed chef and author Adam Liaw.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E13 Harry Aikines-Aryeetey Prue is joined in the kitchen by Harry Aikines-Aryeetey who makes a salted caramel chocolate tart. John and Prue visit Highgrove and the pair then make a Scandinavian fish dish.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E19 Catalonia In Catalonia, James visits the Boqueria market, eats Catalan Paella in Sitges, and takes a tour of a cava vineyard. He cooks cod, spatchcock chicken, cannelloni, and fruit in cava creme anglaise.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 In this episode, Adam learns from the trailblazing chefs who are at the very cutting edge of the new Nordic food movement, inventing some of the most bold and exciting culinary creations in the world today.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E20 Girona In Girona, James visits an anchovy producer, sees how Ratafia is made, we meet chocolatier. He cooks anchovy topped tortilla, walnut and orange cake, beef fillet and a final tribute to Spain paella.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Scandinavia Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 In this episode, Adam learns from the trailblazing chefs who are at the very cutting edge of the new Nordic food movement, inventing some of the most bold and exciting culinary creations in the world today.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes Xmas
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: 2005 Over the past few years, popular TV chef Rick Stein has embarked on a voyage of discovery, taking him the length and breadth of Britain as he searches out the very best of all British produce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Precious Flavours
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Le Tolminc Tolminc cheese is a treasure from Slovenia, Europe's greenest country. The flowers and pastures in the Soca valley give the milk it is produced from a rare flavour.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E9 Peppers And Chillies Jamie makes a delicious spicy pork goulash using a variety of ingredients from the capsicum family.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E16 A Day At The Market Lidia has always loved trips to the food market as they have always been an adventure since childhood. She males shrimp roasted pepper and olive salad, then eggplant parmigiana stacks.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Cheddar Will and daughter Ellie visit England's South West, a region famous for producing the world's finest cheddar cheese.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: What Chefs Want
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Multicultural Melting Pot Renae and Sally embark on am adventure through the vibrant cultural mosaic of Singapore. Local expert Chef Damian D'Silva introduces Renae to a world of flavour at the Geylang Serai Markets.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Vintimille Luana Belmondo takes us to the heart of a vibrant and welcoming town. Here, the dolce vita is all about markets, meaningful encounters, and authentic flavours.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Tales From The Orchard Sophie helps with the cherry harvest and uses them in a favourite pastry.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E8 Elijah Prewitt: Asian Style Crayfish With Green Pawpaw Salad Elijah's cooking influence comes from living in Broome and growing up with many of his mates, eating whatever was caught from the ocean and the inlands.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Party For 20 Maggie asks Simon to help prepare for a party for 20 of her friends. She devises a menu that could be easily doubled or tripled depending on the size of the party.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E21 Episode 21 Laura is joined by vegan Liz Douglas, who makes an incredibly controversial Avocado Pasta that must be seen to be believed.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E21 Italian Paninis In honour of the legendary singer and Rachael's dear friend Tony Bennett, she prepares osso buco, a dish of succulent braised veal shanks served Florentine style in the oven with large slices of bread.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E9 Tropical North Queensland Hayden returns to one of his favourite destinations, Tropical North Queensland, for an unforgettable food adventure in paradise. Expect reef-to-rainforest flavours, inspiring and jaw-dropping scenery.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E11 Episode 11 We are baking up a storm with Ash Pollard's delicious spiced Carrot Cake.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E16 Episode 16 Nonnas, look away now, as Laura starts the show making a cheat's version of the classic Italian recipe, Tortellini in Brodo.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E14 Episode 14 Rick watches as friend Bill Baker fishes on the Towy estuary and catches flounder. Rick cooks flounder with a ravigote sauce. Bill catches a sea trout and Rick cooks it marinated with dill and pernod.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E45 Episode 45 Today's episode of Everyday Gourmet showcases some delicious recipes including Mushroom and Lemon Thyme Butter Spelt Spaghetti, Gin Cured Kingfish with Beetroot and Banana and Sour Cream Cake!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E78 Culinary Tour Don't miss The Cook Up's culinary tour! Adam and his guests, TV presenter and maths whiz Lily Serna and acclaimed chef Guillaume Brahimi, are celebrating a world of flavour.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Norway Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Episode 1 One of Norway's most beautiful cities and the perfect place to start. Justine heads straight to the famous fish market, tracking down the ingredients for a classic Norwegian fish soup.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Stories
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E15 West Country In the West Country, Rick meets an organic food pioneer, a famous female cheesemaker and the master of simple British food, chef Mark Hix. Then, he cooks his own veggie dishes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Crayfish And Melons Chef Tom Kerridge journeys from Extremadura to Murcia in his bespoke vintage food truck as he heads to the moon-like landscape of Extremadura and finds signs of life in a lake full of crayfish.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E10 Mushrooms A lack of mushrooms in Jamie's garden inspires to him to go search in his local forest, taking along his mentor and mushroom don, Gennaro Contaldo.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E17 The 1980s Italian American \ The 1980s brought a lot of Northern Italian cuisine to New York City. Lidia shares her recipes for a pasta primavera 'new school', and the classic raspberry and walnut butter cookies.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Comte Comte is one of the most popular cheeses in France and the most important of all those made under the strict French appellation system. Will traces the links between farmer, cheese maker and affineur.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: What Chefs Want
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 The Beauty Of Modern Singapore Get ready to feast your eyes on the innovative stunning dishes that define modern Singaporean cuisine. Like exploring TV personality Ben Yeo's restaurant and some of Singapore's most unique places.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Sanremo In Sanremo, the dolce vita is lived with elegance and flair. A legendary destination where glamour, music and gastronomy come together.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Fresh From The Lagoon Sophie meets a mussel farmer on the lagoon at Taranto. At home she prepares a mussel, potato and rice gratin and cooks an octopus stew for her guests at the trulli.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E9 Cauline & Bubba Masuda: Black Bean Fish With Cabbage & Sasami Drawing on their father's Japanese and mother's Bard heritage, Bubba prepare two dishes that have us going back down memory lane of our childhoods.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 A Luscious Lunch The season is on the change and Maggie and Simon prepare for an early autumn lunch. As Maggie lives in the Barossa, on Saturdays she shops at the Barossa Market.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E22 Episode 22 We go Italian with guest cook Dezi Madafferi as she prepares a delicious Crumbed Veal Cotoletta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E22 Osso Bucco It's sandwich night in Rachael's kitchen and she's serving up an array of Italian sandwiches with ingredients like roasted eggplant, sweet bell peppers, spicy mortadella with pistachio, and much more.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E4 Tasmania's North West Hayden explores the wild beauty of North West Tasmania, where dramatic coastlines and lush farmlands produce some of the country's finest ingredients.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E12 Episode 12 It's a Chocolate lovers dream on today's Sweet Edition.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E17 Episode 17 Laura starts with delicious Monte Carlo Biscuits which she shares with Stallholder John Pino. Catherine Velisha makes a Cucumber Smash, a quick and easy salad that is chock-full of vegetables.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E15 Episode 15 Rick visits his favourite local fish market at Looe in Cornwall, and he cooks John Dory with potatoes and mushrooms. In Northumberland, Rick cooks up pancakes with cheese, spinach, and ham.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E46 Episode 46 Justine and guest Kate Weiss get creative on today's episode with Dukkah Crumbed Prawns with Rocket and Pear Salad, Spinach Gnudi and a Summer Pudding with Dragon Fruit.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E79 Sunset Supper Join journalist Janice Petersen, chef Matt Golinski and Adam for a night of superb sunset suppers.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eva Pau's Asian Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Episode 5 When time is short but flavour matters, Eva shows how to turn ordinary evenings into something special. She begins with Crispy Peking Beef with Noodles, a quick stir-fry that's crunchy and saucy.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Memory Bites With Matt Moran
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Courtney Act Chef Matt Moran delves into the food memories of multifaceted entertainer Courtney Act, revealing how retro family dishes and deep resilience have illuminated their path to stardom.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Iceland A trip across Iceland gives Tony a deeper understanding of how this island's cuisine is uniquely rooted in local flavours and sustainability.

Each episode features a different group of passengers -- ranging from millionaires to hard-partying friends -- as they head out for a marine adventure. krqedt2.us.title: Benson
krqedt2.us.description: Butler Benson DuBois is the smartest (and possibly only sane) member of widowed Gov. Eugene Gatling's household staff. Benson always manages to keep his head, no matter what the staffers or the governor's family members throw at him. He begins his post on loan from his employer, Jessica Tate (Katherine Helmond) on the show "Soap," but soon wins a permanent place in the governor's staff and heart. His cool head and keen intellect are a perfect complement for the constant craziness that surrounds Gov. Gatling and his entourage. (Sitcom) - 1979-09-13

krqedt2.us.title: One Day at a Time
krqedt2.us.description: This comedy-drama is inspired by Norman Lear's 1975 series of the same name. This time around, the series follows the life of Penelope, a newly single Army veteran, and her Cuban-American family, as they navigate the ups and downs of life. Now a nurse, Penelope is raising two strong-willed children. When faced with challenges, Penelope turns to her "old-school" mother, and her building manager, who has become an invaluable confidant. The series offers a contemporary take on what life looks like in both good and bad times, and how loved ones can help make it all worthwhile. (Comedy drama) - 2017-01-06

The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

fxm.us.title: The Day the Earth Stood Still
fxm.us.description: When a UFO lands in Washington, D.C., bearing a message for Earth's leaders, all of humanity stands still. Klaatu has come on behalf of alien life who have been watching Cold War-era nuclear proliferation on Earth. But it is Klaatu's soft-spoken robot Gort that presents a more immediate threat to onlookers. A single mother and her son teach the world about peace and tolerance in this moral fable, ousting the tanks and soldiers that greet the alien's arrival. (Science fiction) - 1951

fxm.us.title: Prometheus
fxm.us.description: The discovery of a clue to mankind's origins on Earth leads a team of explorers to the darkest parts of the universe. Two brilliant young scientists lead the expedition. Shaw hopes that they will meet a race of benevolent, godlike beings who will in some way verify her religious beliefs, while Holloway is out to debunk any spiritual notions. However, neither the scientists nor their shipmates are prepared for the unimaginable terrors that await them. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 2012

fxm.us.title: Alien: Covenant
fxm.us.description: Bound for a remote planet on the far side of the galaxy, members (Katherine Waterston, Billy Crudup) of the colony ship Covenant discover what they think to be an uncharted paradise. While there, they meet David (Michael Fassbender), the synthetic survivor of the doomed Prometheus expedition. The mysterious world soon turns dark and dangerous when a hostile alien life-form forces the crew into a deadly fight for survival. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 2017

fxm.us.title: Alien vs. Predator
fxm.us.description: A team of scientists on an expedition finds themselves caught up in the cataclysmic battle between aliens and predators - and no matter which species wins, the humans lose. - 2004

fxm.us.title: Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem

fxm.us.title: Missing

However, as she digs ever deeper, her digital sleuthing soon raises more questions than answers. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2023

fxm.us.title: The Song of Bernadette
fxm.us.description: Based on the popular novel by Franz Werfel, this drama focuses on Bernadette Soubirous (Jennifer Jones), a young French woman who experiences vivid visions of the Virgin Mary. While many dismiss her claims, certain people, including the priest Dominique Peyramale (Charles Bickford), slowly begin to believe her. Eventually, Bernadette is deemed a saint, and becomes a nun at a convent, where she must deal with jealousy from others who resent her revered status. (Drama) - 1943

fxm.us.title: Rebecca of Sunnybrook Farm
fxm.us.description: After Rebecca (Shirley Temple) is mistakenly rejected at an audition for a radio advertising campaign, her stepfather takes her upstate to stay at Sunnybrook Farm with her Aunt Miranda (Helen Westley), who bans her from show business. Meanwhile, advertising exec Tony Kent (Randolph Scott) desperately searches for Rebecca, who he has only heard, unaware that she's on the farm next to his. Tony's search is interrupted by many things -- including Rebecca's attractive cousin, Gwen (Gloria Stuart). (Musical) - 1938

fxm.us.title: The Three Musketeers
fxm.us.description: In this musical comedy version of Alexandre Dumas' timeless novel, D'Artagnan (Don Ameche), a French peasant with dreams of joining the Musketeers, sets out for Paris. On the road, he comes across the three warriors. Athos (Douglas Dumbrille) challenges D'Artagnan to a duel, but eventually all four become fast friends. The Musketeers make an ally of the Queen of France (Gloria Stuart) and find themselves constantly dueling with the wicked Milady De Winter (Binnie Barnes). (Musical comedy) - 1939

The man, Freddy Krueger (Jackie Earle Haley), terrorizes them in their dreams, and the only escape is to wake up. But when one of their number dies violently, the friends realize that what happens in the dream world is real, and the only way to stay alive is to stay awake. (Horror) - 2010

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Shrek
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Once upon a time, in a far away swamp, there lived an ogre named Shrek whose precious solitude is suddenly shattered by an invasion of annoying fairy tale characters. They were all banished from their kingdom by the evil Lord Farquaad. Determined to save their home, not to mention his, Shrek cuts a deal with Farquaad and sets out to rescue Princess Fiona to be Farquaad's bride. Rescuing the Princess may be small compared to her deep, dark secret. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2001

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Shrek 2
nickelodeonwest.us.description: After returning from their honeymoon and showing home movies to their friends, Shrek and Fiona learn that her parents have heard that she has married her true love and wish to invite him to their kingdom, called Far Far Away. The catch is: Fiona's parents are unaware of the curse that struck their daughter and have assumed she married Prince Charming, not a 700-pound ogre with horrible hygiene and a talking donkey pal. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2004

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Shrek the Third
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Shrek embarks on another whirlwind adventure with Donkey and Puss in Boots to find the rightful heir to the throne. Meet the magical misguided Merlin, an awkward Arthur and a powerful posse of princesses in a tale where everyone lives happily ever laughter. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2007

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Trolls World Tour
nickelodeonwest.us.description: When the Queen of the Hard Rock Trolls tries to take over all the Troll kingdoms, Queen Poppy and her friends try different ways to save all the Trolls. - 2020

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Hotel Transylvania
nickelodeonwest.us.description: An unforeseen complication unfolds when Dracula (Adam Sandler) invites the world's most-infamous monsters to his lavish resort to celebrate his daughter's 118th birthday. - 2012

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With the Stain
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Rachel wants to find her own apartment; Phoebe is ecstatic when Eric (Sean Penn) dumps Ursula to date her.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With the Rumor
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Monica encounters a high-school friend (guest star Brad Pitt) and invites him to Thanksgiving Day dinner.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Engagement Reaction
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Howard's mom winds up in the hospital after hearing news of her son's engagement to Bernadette.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Roommate Transmogrification
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Bernadette gets her Ph.D., inspiring the guys to tease Wolowitz about his lack of a doctorate; Raj becomes Sheldon's roommate.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Skank Reflex Analysis
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Penny worries that she has ruined her relationship with her friends; Sheldon takes over the paintball team.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Infestation Hypothesis
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Amy is caught in the middle when Penny and Sheldon get into an argument over a pre-owned chair; Leonard tries to make his long-distance relationship more exciting.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Pulled Groin Extrapolation
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Amy and Leonard try to become better acquainted; Bernadette, Howard and Mrs. Wolowitz spend the weekend together.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With Monica's Boots
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Chandler is aghast when Monica buys expensive boots; Phoebe discovers that Ross' son attends school with Sting's son.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With the Creepy Holiday Card
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Ross' new girlfriend wants to put their photograph on Christmas cards; Rachel eyes Joey as a possible partner.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One Where Joey Dates Rachel
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Rachel and Joey might become more than friends; Chandler sets a Ms. Pac-Man record; Ross breaks land-speed records.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One Where Chandler Takes a Bath
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Joey might declare his love for Rachel, or Phoebe; Rachel breaks a pact with Ross; Chandler becomes mister bubble bath.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With the Secret Closet
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Joey realizes his intense feelings for Rachel are excluding Ross from the joys of impending fatherhood.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With the Birthing Video
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Monica prepares a memorable St. Valentine's Day for Chandler with sexy lingerie and X-rated entertainment.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One Where Joey Tells Rachel
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Joey confesses his true feelings for Rachel; Phoebe introduces Monica to her new boyfriend (Harry Van Gorkum).

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With the Tea Leaves
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Rachel devises a lie about her unborn child that she hopes will break the silence between her and Joey; Phoebe reads tea leaves and predicts she will soon encounter the man of her dreams.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One in Massapequa
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Phoebe brings her annoyingly upbeat boyfriend to the 35th anniversary of Monica and Ross' parents, who urge Ross and pregnant Rachel to pretend to be married.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With Joey's Interview
nickelodeonwest.us.description: When Soap Opera Digest requests an interview, Joey enlists his friends to make sure he does not say anything that could cost him his role.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Friends - The One With the Baby Shower
nickelodeonwest.us.description: During her baby shower, Rachel realizes she is unprepared to be a mother and accepts her mother's (Marlo Thomas) offer to move in to help with the child.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Neighborhood - Welcome to the Yard Sale
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Dave convinces Calvin to hold a yard sale, but when longtime neighborhood resident Miss Simpson makes a purchase Calvin quickly regrets, he enlists Dave to help him get the valuable object back.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - As Seen on TV; Can You Spare a Dime
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Stardom goes to SpongeBob's head after he appears in Krabs' low-budget commercial; Squidward becomes impoverished.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Stop the Return of Humsquatch; Pups Save a Lonely Ghost
nickelodeonwest.us.description: When Eddie and Emmy get impatient at the carnival, they hide in Mayor Humdinger's Humsquatch costume to chase everyone out; Rubble dreams that he meets a ghost and learns that it's not easy to help a ghost make new friends.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Pterodactyl; Dino Rescue: Pups and the Big Rumble
nickelodeonwest.us.description: When Maverick the daredevil pterodactyl takes a tumble and hurts his wing, he needs a rescue; a volcano eruption threatens the Dino Wilds.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Stop a Coconut Catapult; Pups Save Humdinger's Goose
nickelodeonwest.us.description: The pups leap into action when Digi and Tal's coconut catapult goes rampant and rockets off through the jungle targeting birds and monkeys.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Save a Giant Chicken; Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Stop Harold's Deep Freeze
nickelodeonwest.us.description: The Mighty Twins join the Mighty Pups to save a giant chicken and the town; the Mighty Pups have to stop Harold Humdinger before he puts Adventure Bay in a deep freeze so he can become mayor.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Rubble and Wild in a Yarn of a Tail; Skye and Rory Flip It; Marshall and Leo Save the Ferris Wheel Passengers; Everest and Shade Save a Mountain Goat
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Rubble and Wild team up to stop a giant runaway yarn ball rolling through town; Marshall and Leo must rescue some critters stuck on a Ferris wheel.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Air Rescue: Pups Save the Airport Opening
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Adventure Bay is getting a new airport! Sweetie tries to take the Princess' place at the grand opening.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save Helga and the Humsquatch; Pups Save the Missing Bone-Stone
nickelodeonwest.us.description: While Humdinger gets dressed for a day with his Hummy Mummy, the Humsquatch accidentally puts on the mayor's suit and takes his place; when a precious bone goes missing, the Pups' only chance at getting it back is to team up with Sweetie.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Water Walker; Sea Patrol: Pups Save a Windsurfer
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Mayor Humdinger swipes Francois' water-walking shoes and ends up trapped in a pit-like turtle nest; the pups spring into action when a nearby volcano erupts.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Tour Bus; Pups Save Midnight at the Museum
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Mayor Humdinger's tour bus goes out of control when he tries to bring tourists to Foggy Bottom; a fun museum sleepover is interrupted when Alex and the mini-patrol go missing, and Mayor Goodway gets stranded on a T. rex.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Pups vs. a Neon Humdinger; Pups Save a Royal Painting
nickelodeonwest.us.description: When Mayor Humdinger's giant neon sign of himself gets loose, the PAW Patrol must stop it from rolling through town.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Rubble & Crew - The Crew Builds a Halloween Maze; The Crew Builds a Giant Pup House
nickelodeonwest.us.description: The crew builds a spooky maze for Halloween; when Omar and Romar get lost in the maze, the pups jump to the rescue; when a spooky movie keeps Rubble awake, the pups come up with a construction solution.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: To Be Announced
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Programming to be announced.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Katie's Arctic Road Trip; Pups Save a Magical Mishap
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Skye, Everest, Liberty and Katie go on a camping adventure where they encounter a polar bear with a sweet tooth; when Julia and Julius put on a magic show, they are convinced they accidentally turned Mr. Carter into a rabbit.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Trick-or-Treaters; Pups Save an Out of Control Mini Patrol
nickelodeonwest.us.description: During Halloween in Adventure Bay, a mysterious kid in a giant spider costume takes all the treats from the trick-or-treaters; Alex and his Mini-Patrol accidentally take off on Daring Danny's rocket bike.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save the Baby Space Rocks; Pups Save the Eddies and Emmys
nickelodeonwest.us.description: When a mysterious storm drops hailstones that hatch into Baby Space Rocks, the Pups must find a way to keep them safe; a 3D printer leads to trouble when Eddie and Emmy make 3D reproductions of themselves and play pranks.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Get Your Goat; Pups Save the Crop Circles
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Cap'n Turbot and his cousin, Francois, observe a pair of mountain goats when a sudden avalanche strikes; Farmer Al finds mysterious crop circles in his corn field, so he calls on the "PAW Patrol" to find out who is making them.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: PAW Patrol - Pups Save a Ghost
nickelodeonwest.us.description: A mysterious ghost is causing havoc at night, but it's not a ghost at all, it's Marshall sleepwalking; now the pups have to save the slumbering pup as he sleepwalks through town.

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Trolls World Tour

nickelodeonwest.us.title: The Boss Baby 2: Family Business
nickelodeonwest.us.description: Now adults, Tim Templeton and his estranged brother, Ted, take a magical formula that transforms them into babies for 48 hours. Together, they must go undercover to prevent an evil genius from turning fellow toddlers into monstrous brats. - 2021

nickelodeonwest.us.title: Despicable Me 3
nickelodeonwest.us.description: The mischievous Minions hope that Gru will return to a life of crime after the new boss of the Anti-Villain League fires him. Instead, Gru decides to remain retired and travel to Freedonia to meet his long-lost twin brother for the first time. The reunited siblings soon find themselves in an uneasy alliance to take down the elusive Balthazar Bratt, a former 1980s child star who seeks revenge against the world. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2017

nickelodeonwest.us.description: Chandler and Joey find a videotape while checking out Richard's apartment; Ross sings Emma an off-color lullaby. (Sitcom) - 2002-11-14

nickelodeonwest.us.description: Rachel has a bone to pick with her self-centered sister (Christina Applegate) on Thanksgiving; Monica protects her good wedding china; Joey forgets to join his TV cast mates for the Thanksgiving parade. (Holiday, Sitcom) - 2002-11-21

showtimewest.us.title: Love & Basketball
showtimewest.us.description: Monica (Sanaa Lathan) and Quincy (Omar Epps) are two childhood friends who both aspire to be professional basketball players. Quincy, whose father, Zeke (Dennis Haysbert), plays for the Los Angeles Clippers, is a natural talent and a born leader. Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart.

showtimewest.us.title: The Bodyguard
showtimewest.us.description: Best-selling pop diva Rachel Marron has a stalker whose obsession has risen to the level of disturbing threats. At the urging of her manager, Rachel hires former Secret Service agent Frank Farmer as her bodyguard. Initially resented and treated with disdain for his hard-nosed security procedures, Farmer soon becomes an integral part of Rachel's inner circle. As they spend more time together, client and protector become closer still.

showtimewest.us.title: Quantum of Solace
showtimewest.us.description: Following the death of Vesper Lynd, James Bond (Daniel Craig) makes his next mission personal. The hunt for those who blackmailed his lover leads him to ruthless businessman Dominic Greene (Mathieu Amalric), a key player in the organization which coerced Vesper. Bond learns that Greene is plotting to gain total control of a vital natural resource, and he must navigate a minefield of danger and treachery to foil the plan.

showtimewest.us.title: Forrest Gump
showtimewest.us.description: Slow-witted Forrest Gump (Tom Hanks) has never thought of himself as disadvantaged, and thanks to his supportive mother (Sally Field), he leads anything but a restricted life. Whether dominating on the gridiron as a college football star, fighting in Vietnam or captaining a shrimp boat, Forrest inspires people with his childlike optimism. But one person Forrest cares about most may be the most difficult to save -- his childhood love, the sweet but troubled Jenny (Robin Wright).

showtimewest.us.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
showtimewest.us.description: Average Joe's Gym and its owner, Peter La Fleur (Vince Vaughn), are both down on their luck. A fancy competing gym called Globo-Gym, run by the maniacal health nut White Goodman (Ben Stiller), is about to put Average Joe's out of business unless Peter can raise $50,000 to keep his mortgage. To save the gym, Peter and a ragtag group of Average Joe's members and employees enter a dodgeball contest with a big cash prize. In response, White forms his own Globo-Gym team to rout the competition.

showtimewest.us.title: Magic Mike
showtimewest.us.description: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister.

showtimewest.us.title: Magic Mike XXL
showtimewest.us.description: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again.

showtimewest.us.title: Pulp Fiction
showtimewest.us.description: Vincent Vega and Jules Winnfield are hitmen with a penchant for philosophical discussions. In this ultra-hip, multi-strand crime movie, their storyline is interwoven with those of their boss, gangster Marsellus Wallace; his actress wife, Mia; struggling boxer Butch Coolidge; master fixer The Wolf and a nervous pair of armed robbers, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny.

showtimewest.us.title: Blade Runner 2049
showtimewest.us.description: Officer K (Ryan Gosling), a new Blade Runner for the Los Angeles Police Department, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. His discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard (Harrison Ford), a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years.

showtimewest.us.title: Molly's Game
showtimewest.us.description: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

showtimewest.us.title: Crawlspace
showtimewest.us.description: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival.

showtimewest.us.title: Godzilla
showtimewest.us.description: Ford Brody (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco when he is forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe (Bryan Cranston). Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake, as they make their way toward their final battleground: San Francisco.

showtimewest.us.title: My Cousin Vinny
showtimewest.us.description: New York lawyer Vinny has never won a case. When his teenage cousin Bill and his friend Stan are accused of murder in a backwater Alabama town, it's up to the nervous Vinny to save him from jail, even though he's only ever tried personal injury cases before, and none of them successfully.

showtimewest.us.title: Old School
showtimewest.us.description: After discovering his girlfriend has been participating in group sex, attorney Mitch feels his world come undone. He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard.

showtimewest.us.title: We're the Millers
showtimewest.us.description: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang.

showtimewest.us.title: Rock of Ages
showtimewest.us.description: The songs of Journey, Bon Jovi, Def Leppard and other artists underscore a tale of big dreams in Hollywood. Soon after hopping off a bus from the Midwest, aspiring singer Sherrie Christian immediately finds herself in trouble. Coming to her rescue is Drew, a bar-back at the legendary club the Bourbon Room. With stars in their eyes, the young lovers chase their dreams, but a misunderstanding involving rock god Stacee Jaxx threatens to tear them apart.

showtimewest.us.title: Jack Reacher
showtimewest.us.description: One morning in an ordinary town, five people are shot dead in a seemingly random attack; all evidence points to a single suspect: an ex-military sniper who is quickly brought into custody; Reacher, an enigmatic ex-Army investigator, believes the authorities have the right man but agrees to help the sniper's defense attorney.. However, the more Reacher delves into the case, the less clear-cut it appears.

showtimewest.us.title: MobLand
showtimewest.us.description: Licking wounds and turning on each other after fleeing Frankie's assault, Seraphina goes all in, pitching the Harrigans on a global power play; Maeve and Harry square off over crossed lines.

showtimewest.us.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
showtimewest.us.description: Investigator Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise) springs into action after the arrest of Susan Turner (Cobie Smulders), an Army major accused of treason. Suspecting foul play, Jack embarks on a mission to prove that the head of his old unit is innocent. After crossing paths with the law, Reacher must now go on the lam to uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy that involves the death of U.S. soldiers.

showtimewest.us.title: Crimes of the Future
showtimewest.us.description: As the human species adapts to a synthetic environment, the body undergoes new transformations and mutations. Accompanied by his partner, celebrity performance artist Saul Tenser showcases the metamorphosis of his organs. Meanwhile, a mysterious group tries to use Saul's notoriety to shed light on the next phase of human evolution.

showtimewest.us.title: Kiss the Girls
showtimewest.us.description: Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova.

showtimewest.us.title: Patriot Games
showtimewest.us.description: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller.

cinevault.us.title: The Art of War
cinevault.us.description: He is both agent and weapon - a critical line of defense for the Secretary General of the United Nations. He does not even officially exist. Neil Shaw, an American agent who must uncover an international plot to bring down the United Nations on the eve of an historic summit with China. A mysterious chain of events leads to the murder of the Chinese U.N. Ambassador. When Shaw is accused of the crime, he must go underground -- in effect, vanish from his own life. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2000-08-23

cinevault.us.title: The Replacement Killers
cinevault.us.description: Hired assassin John Lee (Chow Yun-Fat) is asked by Chinatown crime boss Terence Wei (Kenneth Tsang) to murder the young son of policeman Stan Zedkov (Michael Rooker). Lee has the boy in his sights, but his conscience gets the better of him, and he spares the child's life. Afraid that Wei will take revenge on his family in China, Lee seeks out expert forger Meg Coburn (Mira Sorvino) to obtain the passport he needs to get out of the country, but a band of replacement killers is soon on his trail. (Action, Movie) - 1998

cinevault.us.title: Godzilla
cinevault.us.description: During a nuclear test, the French government inadvertently mutates a lizard nest; years later, a giant lizard makes its way to New York City. Dr. Niko Tatopoulos, an expert on the effects of radiation on animals, is sent by the U.S. government to study the beast. When the creature, dubbed "Godzilla" by news outlets, emerges, a massive battle with the military begins. To make matters worse, Niko discovers that Godzilla has laid a nest of 200 eggs, which are ready to hatch. (Action, Movie, Science fiction) - 1998-05-19

cinevault.us.title: The Exorcism of Emily Rose
cinevault.us.description: The Rev. Moore is prosecuted for the wrongful death of a girl thought to be demonically possessed, because he administered the church-sanctioned exorcism that ultimately killed her. Prosecuting attorney Ethan Thomas contends that the young woman, Emily, suffered from schizophrenia and should have been medically diagnosed. Meanwhile, defense lawyer Erin Bruner argues that Emily's condition cannot be explained by science alone. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2005-09-09

cinevault.us.title: Lakeview Terrace
cinevault.us.description: An uptight cop (Samuel L. Jackson), the self-appointed watchdog of his neighborhood, strongly disapproves of the interracial newlyweds (Patrick Wilson, Kerry Washington) who just moved in next door. He becomes increasingly hostile toward the innocent pair, going to great lengths to force them out of their home. The situation changes when the young couple decide to fight back. (Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2008-09-19

cinevault.us.title: Talhotblond
cinevault.us.description: Thomas meets a beautiful teenager online, with whom he engages in a nearly two-year romance over the Internet until she learns the truth about him, which leads Thomas to exact the ultimate revenge. (Documentary, Movie, Thriller) - 2009-02-01

cinevault.us.title: The Deal
cinevault.us.description: Laura's family dies in a fire while living in Spain, and as she prepares to move back to the United States, she learns their deaths were not accidental. She goes undercover to find out the truth and becomes embroiled in mob crimes. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2006

cinevault.us.title: Facing the Giants
cinevault.us.description: Grant Taylor, a Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick), gets some very bad news. Besides his and his wife's (Shannen Fields) infertility problems, he faces the attempt of local parents to force the school to replace him. His team, the Shiloh Eagles, has never had a winning season in the six years that he has coached the boys. Following a visitor's message, Grant tries to inspire his team to use faith to conquer fear and opposing teams. (Action, Drama, Movie) - 2006-09-29

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: The Himalayas A documentary looking at the variety of wild animals inhabiting the Himalayas.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: Badgers: Secrets of the Sett While badgers are easily recognized, remarkably few people have ever seen one alive; it's a creature blamed for destruction and disease, but surprisingly little is known about the sett society.

bbcearth.us.title: Natural World
bbcearth.us.description: S01 E01 Echo Ely and Friends - Africa's Forgotten Elephants This film goes beyond events at the Amboseli National Park, in search of elephants living in Africa's vast landscape.

bbcearth.us.title: 24 Hours on Earth

bbcearth.us.title: 24 Hours on Earth

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Babies

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Babies

bbcearth.us.title: Animal Babies

homeful.us.description: S01 E07 See Danielle return to the lake house and face some unexpected challenges.

homeful.us.title: Lien on Me
homeful.us.description: S01 E01 Problems with a contractor halt the addition of a much-needed second floor.

homeful.us.title: Holmes & Holmes
homeful.us.description: S02 E07 Here We Go Again Mike and MJ are welcomed back to the river house by a river of muck; they rush to get the house closed in before winter; they purchase a new property, but Mike throws a monkey wrench into their renovation plan and budget.

homeful.us.title: Holmes & Holmes
homeful.us.description: S02 E08 Game Changer Mike's vision for the suburban house hits a structural snag, and MJ attempts to rein him in before the budget takes another hit; Mike throws another curveball at MJ that could have serious repercussions for their business plan.

homeful.us.title: Holmes & Holmes
homeful.us.description: S02 E09 River House of Dreams Sarah Richardson advises on the design of the master en suite at the country house; the guys use cool technology to improve energy efficiency; the pressure is on for MJ who wants to surprise his father with finishing touches at the river house.

homeful.us.title: Holmes & Holmes
homeful.us.description: S02 E10 Smart Suburban Holmes With the interior of the river house complete, it's time to focus on the suburban home as the open house date fast approaches; Mike, MJ and the crew work feverishly to get the smart home ready and receive the valuation they're hoping to earn.

homeful.us.title: Holmes & Holmes
homeful.us.description: S02 E11 A Thousand Goodbyes Flooring takes center stage inside the country house, while the barn's exterior is finally completed; the river house gets its finishing touches as Mike and MJ prepare to say goodbye to the Thousand Islands.

homeful.us.title: Holmes & Holmes
homeful.us.description: S02 E12 The Holmes Stretch The first property that Mike Holmes and MJ bought is the last to be finished; there's still a ton of work to be done; Mike and MJ race to complete the landscaping while finishing the interior to Mike's exacting standards.

homeful.us.title: Coolest Places to Stay
homeful.us.description: S01 E01 Living Larger Luxurious short-term rentals designed for group vacationers.

homeful.us.title: Sugar Showdown
homeful.us.description: S02 E01 Viva Italia Donuts Bakers compete in a speedy elimination round using basil as their mystery ingredient; remaining two compete for $10,000 in a Viva Italia-themed donut showdown.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Phoenix
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: After undergoing reconstructive surgery, a concentration camp survivor (Nina Hoss) tries to find out if her husband (Ronald Zehrfeld) betrayed her to the Nazis.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Queer for Fear: The History of Queer Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 Queer gothic writers Mary Shelley, Oscar Wilde and Bram Stoker invent the horror genre with "Frankenstein," "The Picture of Dorian Gray" and "Dracula"; when cinema arrives, queer director F.W. Murnau shocks the world with his queer-coded "Nosferatu."

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Queer for Fear: The History of Queer Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Gay director James Whale makes four classics that pave the way for all Hollywood horror movies after, but his career was dimmed by anti-gay sentiment; Alfred Hitchcock uses queer characters and queer coded stories to keep audiences in suspense.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Queer for Fear: The History of Queer Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 Werewolves, cat people, body-snatchers and doppelgängers are uniquely queer metaphors; from the classic "The Wolf Man" to queer-authored "Cat People," the monsters of the 1940s express shame and seek to rid themselves of the secret self.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Queer for Fear: The History of Queer Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E04 The dangerous queer woman has been terrorizing horror audiences since before the dawn of cinema; the lesbian vampire sucks the lifeblood from women and men alike in the gothic novella "Carmilla" and films like "Dracula's Daughter."

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Keeper of Lost Causes
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: Police inspector Carl Mørck and his assistant investigate a cold case involving a missing woman.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 Zombies Zombies are the monsters of the 21st century, and America's major contribution to horror; a look at what set off zombie fever leads to George Romero, who made zombies a metaphor for social ills.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E01 Houses of Hell Home is where the heart is, unless one lives in a house of hell; whether they're filled with specters or psychos, every house of hell pokes at illusions of comfort and safety.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cold Blooded: The Clutter Family Murders
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 Farm Family Slain In November 1959, four members of the Clutter family are brutally murdered in their home in a small Kansas farming community.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cold Blooded: The Clutter Family Murders
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Killers on the Run Kansas law enforcement survey the aftermath of the seemingly unmotivated crime, while criminals Perry Smith and Richard Hickock go on the lam.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cold Blooded: The Clutter Family Murders
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 The Intruders on Trial Detailing the resulting investigation and convictions of Perry Smith and Richard Hickock, along with the ensuing media coverage.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cold Blooded: The Clutter Family Murders
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E04 The Gallows and the Novel As Perry Smith and Richard Hickock face a death sentence, Truman Capote's coverage of the infamous case and his ensuing novel, "In Cold Blood," spawns the modern American True Crime genre.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Jonestown: Terror in the Jungle
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 Making of a Madman Sadistic preacher Jim Jones forms the Peoples Temple after an unusual childhood; the cult's members are captivated; Jones' lust for power becomes unstoppable.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Jonestown: Terror in the Jungle
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 On the Run The press exposes the dark side of Jim Jones, causing a mass exodus to Jonestown; his followers soon realize it's not the utopia their leader promised.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Jonestown: Terror in the Jungle
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 Under Siege A heroic congressman travels to Jonestown; Temple members plot their escape; Jim Jones realizes the walls are closing in and plans his final stand.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Jonestown: Terror in the Jungle
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E04 Death in the Promised Land The world learns about the mass murder-suicide in Jonestown, orchestrated by cult leader Jim Jones; survivors try to piece their lives back together.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Rebekah Heath It was a mystery that plagued law enforcement for over years: four unidentified bodies found inside barrels in the woods; one woman searching for answers from her own troubled past sets herself on a journey to give the victims back their names.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Citizen Detective
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E06 Josh Hallmark A young man whose childhood was marked by tragedy learns of a relatively unknown serial killer, and finds himself thinking about unidentified victims; it isn't long before that pursuit becomes a full-time job and identifying victims an obsession.

glorykickboxing.us.title: GLORY: Collision 4
glorykickboxing.us.description: Features Badr Hari vs. Alistair Overeem rubber match, Tiffany van Soest vs. Sarah Moussaddak, Sergej Maslobojev vs. Tarik Khbabez, Tyjani Beztati vs. Stoyan Koprivlenski and Petchpanomrung Kiatmookao vs. Abraham Vidales. From Arnhem, Netherlands.

glorykickboxing.us.title: GLORY 82 Bonn
glorykickboxing.us.description: Features Alim Nabiyev vs. Endy Semeleer for vacant GLORY welterweight title, plus Jahfarr Wilnis vs. Michal Blawdziewicz in kickboxing action from Bonn, Germany.

glorykickboxing.us.title: GLORY 83
glorykickboxing.us.description: Features Sergej Maslobojev vs. Donegi Abena for GLORY light heavyweight title, plus Donovan Wisse vs. Cesar Almeida for GLORY middleweight title from Essen, Germany.

glorykickboxing.us.title: GLORY 84
glorykickboxing.us.description: Features GLORY lightweight champion Tyjani Beztati vs. GLORY featherweight champion Petchpanomrung Kiatmookao in kickboxing action from Rotterdam, Netherlands.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Warriors Of Virtue
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: A disabled teen enters a magical realm where warrior-kangaroos battle evil, finding his true strength in this action-packed fantasy.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: The Bounty
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Anthony Hopkins delivers a brilliant portrayal as William Bligh, the sea captain who, in 1787, steered The Bounty on a 27,000-mile voyage into danger, chaos and madness, and whose first mate (Mel Gibson) lead a legendary mutiny against him..

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Firewalker
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Invasion U.S.A.
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: An army of terrorist mercenaries led by Soviet agent Rostov (Richard Lynch) catches America unprepared and makes it into a war zone. Only one man can stem the rising tide of violence: retired agent and martial arts expert Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris).

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Code Of Silence
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Chuck Norris stars in this turbo-charged thriller that pits an honest cop against two crime lords and his own department. Henry Silva and Dennis Farina also star in a film that explodes with heart-stopping chases and martial arts confrontations.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: 10 To Midnight
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Charles Bronson is Leo Kessler, a cynical cop on the trail of Warren Stacy (Gene Davis), a homicidal maniac. When the legal system sets Stacy free, Kessler has one option: to hunt down Stacy on his own before the crazed killer can strike again!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Assassination
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Hard-hitting action, cross-country adventure and a government conspiracy that goes all the way to the top highlight this pulse-pounding political thriller in which Charles Bronson must protect the First Lady (Jill Ireland) from ruthless assassins.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Kalifornia
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: A couple (David Duchovny, Michelle Forbes) sets out on a cross-country trip to research a book about serial killers and, along the way, pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend (Brad Pitt, Juliette Lewis) who take them on a ride they'll never forget.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Terror in a Texas Town
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, and learns that his father was murdered two days prior. George discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Cast a Long Shadow
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A young man without surname inherits a big indebted ranch and has to prove his worthiness managing a cattle drive.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: From Noon Till Three
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A frontier widow (Jill Ireland) makes a pulp-novel legend out of her three-hour affair with a third-rate outlaw (Charles Bronson).

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Alias Jesse James
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: The outlaw (Wendell Corey) tries to kill an insurance agent (Bob Hope) who has been mistaken for him in order to collect on a big policy.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Three Amigos!
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Three silent-film cowboys (Chevy Chase, Steve Martin, Martin Short) come to Mexico to perform but instead are expected to save a town.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Quigley Down Under
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: An Old West sharpshooter goes to Australia, where his new boss expects him to kill Aboriginal Australians.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Wild Bill
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: The legendary gunfighter (Jeff Bridges) resumes romance with Calamity Jane (Ellen Barkin), faces an upstart and copes with his past in late-1800s Dakota Territory.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Claim
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Twenty years after a town's founder (Peter Mullan) trades his wife and daughter for a gold claim, the two arrive in his town.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A scout (Lee Marvin) and his Indian sidekick (Oliver Reed) find their ex-partner (Robert Culp) spending their loot in 1908 Colorado.

mysterysciencetheater3000.us.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
mysterysciencetheater3000.us.description: S04 E17 Crash of the Moons "Crash of the Moons" (1954) Science Fiction. Our hero fights evil in outer space. From the "Rocky Jones, Space Ranger" TV series.

mysterysciencetheater3000.us.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
mysterysciencetheater3000.us.description: S03 E18 Star Force: Fugitive Alien II "Star Force: Fugitive Alien II" (1986) Space loner Ken, from Valnastar, guides Earth spaceship Bacchus III on a mission to a far planet.

mysterysciencetheater3000.us.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
mysterysciencetheater3000.us.description: S08 E13 Jack Frost "Jack Frost" (1966) Kids. Grandfather Frost freezes a girl; a villager thaws her.

mysterysciencetheater3000.us.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
mysterysciencetheater3000.us.description: S04 E19 The Rebel Set "The Rebel Set" (1959) Suspense. A coffeehouse owner (Edward Platt) and three arty types scheme to rob an armored car.

mysterysciencetheater3000.us.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
mysterysciencetheater3000.us.description: S08 E17 Horror of Party Beach "Horror of Party Beach" (1964) Horror. Rockin' gilled monsters crash a beach bash; with John Scott; Alice Lyon.

mysterysciencetheater3000.us.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
mysterysciencetheater3000.us.description: S06 E21 The Beast of Yucca Flats Communists chase a large scientist into an atomic-bomb test.

mysterysciencetheater3000.us.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
mysterysciencetheater3000.us.description: S06 E08 Code Name: Diamond Head "Code Name: Diamond Head" (1977) Suspense. An undercover agent hunts spies in Hawaii. With Roy Thinnes, France Nuyen, Ian McShane.

mysterysciencetheater3000.us.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
mysterysciencetheater3000.us.description: S08 E16 Prince of Space "Prince of Space" (1959) Science fiction. Planet Prince arrives in a flying saucer to save Earth from Phantom Mission. With Tatsuo Umemiya, Joji Oda and Hiroko Mine.

mysterysciencetheater3000.us.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000
mysterysciencetheater3000.us.description: The Land The Time Forgot A motley group aboard a German U-boat discovers an island full of ancient beasts.

hallmarkmovies&more.us.title: Good Witch
hallmarkmovies&more.us.description: Catherine Bell reprises her role of Cassie Nightingale in this series based on "The Good Witch" franchise of made-for-TV movies. Nightingale, the titular sorceress, embarks on a magical journey with teenage daughter Grace, who shares her mother's intuitive charm. When divorced Dr. Sam Radford and his teenage son move next door, they are quickly drawn to the Nightingales' unique prowess. Sam realizes that Cassie's signature charm is more than just a magic touch, ensuring the quaint town of Middleton is in for big surprises. (Drama, Romance) - 2015-02-28

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: The Island
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: In 2019 a mercenary (Djimon Hounsou) pursues two clones (Ewan McGregor, Scarlett Johansson) who escaped from a research facility after learning their true fate.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Eagle Eye
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: Two strangers (Shia LaBeouf, Michelle Monaghan) become pawns of a mysterious woman who threatens their friends and family and uses technology to control their actions.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Escape From Alcatraz
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: A hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz, America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Hard Rain
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: A thief (Morgan Freeman), a sheriff (Randy Quaid) and the nephew (Christian Slater) of an armored-truck driver seek money bags in a flooding Indiana town.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Collateral
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: A contract killer hijacks a cab and forces the driver to transport him to his assigned jobs in Los Angeles.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Changing Lanes
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: An attorney and a recovering alcoholic have a car accident which swiftly escalates into an ongoing, bitter feud.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: The Hunted
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: After its boat capsizes, a group of migrants is rescued by rich Europeans who offer shelter on the island where they are vacationing. The miracle becomes a nightmare when the saviors reveal their true plan and turn into ruthless man hunters.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: The Core
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: In order to save mankind, scientists and astronauts must set off a nuclear device at the center of the Earth.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: The Time Machine
miramaxmoviechannel.us.description: A scientist (Guy Pearce) travels into the future and meets a race of people who fear hideous monsters living under the ground.

miramaxmoviechannel.us.title: Congo

shadesofblack.us.title: Belly
shadesofblack.us.description: Ever since they were kids, Sincere (Nas) and Buns (DMX) have lived life close to the edge, doing whatever it takes to survive. As adults, they build up their kingdom of crime on drug dealing and robbery. But Sincere grows weary of the criminal lifestyle and joins a black Muslim religious group. Buns, on the other hand, sinks deeper into criminality and faces serious prison time. The cops offer him a deal, however -- assassinate the head of the Muslim group, and he will go free. (Crime drama, Thriller, Music) - 1998

shadesofblack.us.title: Belly 2: Millionaire Boyz Club
shadesofblack.us.description: After eight years in prison, G (Jayceon Taylor) is released and returns to his old ways on the streets -- until he starts to fall for a policewoman (Shari Headley). (Drama) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: State Property
shadesofblack.us.description: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash). (Crime drama) - 2002

shadesofblack.us.title: State Property 2
shadesofblack.us.description: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone. (Crime drama) - 2005

shadesofblack.us.title: The Inspection
shadesofblack.us.description: A young, gay Black man with few options for his future decides to join the Marines, willing to do whatever it takes to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that would otherwise cast him aside. However, even as he battles deep-seated prejudice and the grueling rigor of basic training, he finds unexpected camaraderie, strength and support in this new community, giving him a hard-won sense of belonging that shapes his identity and forever changes his life. (Drama, LGBTQ) - 2022

shadesofblack.us.title: Soldier Boyz
shadesofblack.us.description: Veteran Howard Toliver (Michael Dudikoff) works at a prison for extremely dangerous juvenile offenders. Recruited to rescue a wealthy girl being held captive in Vietnam, he assembles a team composed of some of the most violent inmates, many of whom are enemies. After battling their way through the jungle, they lay siege to the fortress of the brutal warlord Vinh Moc (Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa), who has the hostage hidden away. Will they work together, or allow their rivalries to consume them? (Action) - 1995

shadesofblack.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
shadesofblack.us.description: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1995

shadesofblack.us.title: The Message
shadesofblack.us.description: Detective Andrea Oya and FBI agent Samantha Curry team up and hunt down a serial killer to solve a string of murders targeting Black women and Black children. (Drama) - 2024

shadesofblack.us.title: A Snowy Day in Oakland
shadesofblack.us.description: A beautiful psychologist from San Francisco decides to end a stalled romance with her high-profile psychiatrist boyfriend and business partner. She moves on with her life by opening her own practice in a vacant office space in the middle of a small commercial block located across the bay in Oakland, turning the predominately African American and psychologically ignored neighborhood on its emotional ear. (Comedy) - 2023

When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes). (Horror, Mystery, Science fiction) - 1998
