truehistory.us.title: Jesus and His Jewish Influences - The Jewish Diaspora and the Golden Rule
truehistory.us.description: Insights into the ancient Jewish diaspora communities; close readings of the Book of Tobit and the Book of Esther; insights into the directions from books about holiness and the treatment of other people; a historical literary debate. (Religious) - 2015-12-11

truehistory.us.title: Jesus and His Jewish Influences - Alexander the Great's Impact on the Jews
truehistory.us.description: Alexander the Great's visit to Jerusalem and Judea; his influence on the development of ancient Jewish traditions; examining possible narrative parallels between these two iconic figures of Western history. (Religious) - 2015-12-11

truehistory.us.title: Jesus and His Jewish Influences - Jews and Greek Rule: The Heliodorus Affair
truehistory.us.description: The Heliodorus Affair; the power struggle between Jerusalem's elite families during the time of the Ptolemies and Seleucids; how it is a key turning point in the history of Jews in Judea; echoes of this conflict in Gospel accounts of taxation. (Religious) - 2015-12-11

truehistory.us.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe - The Journey Ahead
truehistory.us.description: Cosmology takes the entire universe as its subject, not just its form, structure and contents, but also the manner of its birth and evolution; looking at the origin of cosmology in creation stories and its relation to the journey ahead. (Educational) - 2008-11-14

truehistory.us.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe - Denizens of the Universe
truehistory.us.description: Introducing the hierarchy of structures in the universe; from planets to stars, galaxies, galaxy clusters and larger groupings of galaxies called the cosmic web; light travels at a finite speed, looking far away also means looking far back in time. (Educational) - 2008-11-14

truehistory.us.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe - Overall Cosmic Properties
truehistory.us.description: Discussing cosmic properties; the universe is lumpy at the scale of galaxies and galaxy clusters; at larger scales, it is smooth and similar in all directions; this property of homogeneity and isotropy is called the cosmological principle. (Educational) - 2008-11-14

truehistory.us.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe - The Stuff of the Universe
truehistory.us.description: The most familiar constituents of the universe are atomic matter and light; neutrinos make up another component; 96 percent of the universe is dark energy and dark matter; the relative amounts of these constituents changes as the universe expands. (Educational) - 2008-11-14

truehistory.us.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe - The Sweep of Cosmic History
truehistory.us.description: Taking a trip through the universal timeline from the big bang to a future of ever-accelerating expansion; the eight key stages between them include the condensation of atoms, the birth of the first stars and the formation of galaxies. (Educational) - 2008-11-14

truehistory.us.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe - Measuring Distances
truehistory.us.description: Astronomers overlap techniques of "distance ladder" to determine distances in the universe; triangulation works for nearby stars; observers use pulsating stars for farther objects, the rotation of galaxies and a class of supernova explosions. (Educational) - 2008-11-14

truehistory.us.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe - Expansion and Age
truehistory.us.description: Measuring the Doppler shift of galaxies in the early 20th century; observations reveal that they all were moving away from Earth; the more distant ones move faster, proportional to distance; this is the Hubble Law, implying the initial "big bang." (Educational) - 2008-11-14

truehistory.us.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe - Distances, Appearances, and Horizons
truehistory.us.description: Professor Whittle defines distances in cosmology; the three important distances to consider is the emission distance when the light is set out; the current distance, when the light arrives; the distance the light travels. (Educational) - 2008-11-14

truehistory.us.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates - Ramapithecus-Ape Man
truehistory.us.description: Illustrating scientific debates over the rise of humans; the ancestry casts Ramapithecus out; witnessing fossil evidence and molecular evidence, working both together and independently; explaining some of anthropology's most complex issues. (Science) - 2011-07-15

truehistory.us.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates - Australopithecus afarensis-Ancestor or Not?
truehistory.us.description: Discovering and debating over fossil remains of a possible Homo ancestor, Australopithecus afarensis, in 1970; following the story from the perspective of the key personalities involved, scientists Don Johanson and Richard Leakey. (Science) - 2011-07-15

truehistory.us.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates - Ardipithecus-Hominin or Not?
truehistory.us.description: Discovering the 4.4-million-year-old remains of Ardipithecus ramidus; debating whether it is a true hominin or not; suggesting a mix between an effective climber and walking bipedally; examining the fossil and genetic evidence of this "ground ape." (Science) - 2011-07-15

truehistory.us.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates - Brain Structure Versus Brain Size
truehistory.us.description: A human's brain separates them more from apes than any other anatomical feature; investigating the gradual increase in hominid brain size; fossil skulls revealing facts about blood circulation; shedding light on brain size and skull structure. (Science) - 2011-07-15

truehistory.us.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates - The Dietary Hypothesis
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the link between diet and morphology in Australopithecus robustus and Africanus; the teeth and jaws of these two species offer fierce debates about dietary hypotheses; adaptive differences between robust and gracile hominids. (Science) - 2011-07-15

truehistory.us.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates - Africa or Asia?
truehistory.us.description: Wondering whether Africa or Asia is closer to human origins; drawing on the ideas and theories of prominent scientists like Charles Darwin, Ernst Haeckel and Louis Leakey; learning how scientists trace the origin and evolution of the genus Homo. (Science) - 2011-07-15

truehistory.us.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates - An Ape's View of the Oldowan
truehistory.us.description: Tools mark a major step in evolution, but even chimpanzees can make and use tools; Professor Martin offers a detailed picture of early stone toolmakers, illustrating some of the primitive tools found in parts of Africa. (Science) - 2011-07-15

truehistory.us.title: The Rise of Humans: Great Scientific Debates - Who Was Homo habilis?
truehistory.us.description: Fossil records reveal that Homo habilis serves as a transitional marker between Australopithecines and the rest of the genus Homo; Homo habilis has the anatomy to be ancestors of the genus Homo yet not exist at the right time in evolutionary history. (Science) - 2011-07-15

classica.us.title: B. Strozzi - Sino alla morte
classica.us.description: Der argentinische Dirigent und Cembalist Leonardo García Alarcón führt sein Ensemble Cappella Mediterranea durch ein Programm italienischer Barockmusik. Das Ensemble spielt einige der schönsten Barockstücke von Francesco Cavalli. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2023-05-26

classica.us.title: Heyward dirigiert Dvořáks Sinfonie Nr. 9
classica.us.description: Es ist eins der beliebtesten Stücke aller Zeiten: Mit der Aufführung von der 9. Sinfonie e-Moll unter dem Namen "Aus der Neuen Welt" von Antonín Dvořáks gibt der amerikanische Dirigent Jonathon Heyward mit dem "London Symphony Orchestra" sein Debüt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-10-04

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Johan de Meij: Echoes of San Marco & Fellini
classica.us.description: Dieses Konzert ist die Frucht der Kooperation der Konservatorien Giuseppe Nicolini und Giuseppe Verdi. Auf dem Programm stehen Werke des niederländischen Dirigenten und Komponisten Johan de Meij. Echoes of San Marco ist eine Hommage an den venezianischen Renaissance-Komponisten Giovanni Gabrieli. Echoes of San Marco beginnt mit einem Zitat aus Gabrielis Canzon Septimi Toni aus der Sacrae Symphoniae und wurde genau wie das Originalwerk für zwei Chöre aus Blechblasinstrumenten komponiert. (Special, Music, Entertainment) - 2019-02-01

classica.us.title: Ginandrea Noseda
classica.us.description: Dieser Dokumentarfilm berichtet über den italienischen Dirigenten Gianandrea Noseda. (Special, Music, Documentary) - 2017-08-24

classica.us.title: Chopin - 1. und 2. Klavierkonzert
classica.us.description: Antoni Wit dirigiert die Warschauer Philharmoniker in einer Konzertperformance von Frédéric Chopins Klavierkonzert Nr. 1, Op. 11, und Nr. 2, Op. 21 und eine Zugabe gibt es auch. Die Solisten sind die Pianisten Nikolai Demidenko und Evgeny Kissin. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2021-09-24

classica.us.title: Danielpour - Elegies
classica.us.description: Hartmut Haenchen leitet das Orchester der Philharmonie zuidnederland in einem Konzert von Richard Danielpours "Elegies". Solisten sind Marina Prudenskaya und Thomas Oliemans. Die Aufnahme entstand 2019 im Muziekgebouw Eindhoven in den Niederlanden. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-04-04

classica.us.title: Ice Dance: Dornröschen
classica.us.description: Die Imperial Ice Stars, ein Ensemble aus 26 Eiskunstläufern, bieten neue Blickwinkel auf die Geschichte Dornröschens. Aufgenommen 2004 in der Melbourne Theatre Company in Australien mit musikalischer Untermalung von Kompositionen von Tschaikowsky.

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Mariss Jansons
classica.us.description: Mariss Jansons probt mit dem Oslo Philharmonischen Orchester die kraftvolle Suite aus Béla Bartóks Pantomimenballett "Der wunderbare Mandarin", gefolgt von einer Aufführung des gleichen Stücks aus dem Konzerthaus von Oslo.

classica.us.title: Tschaikowsky - Iolanta
classica.us.description: Tschaikowskys „Iolanta" und Strawinskys „Persephone" stellen beide ein Ideal von Schönheit, Poesie und Hoffnung dar. Diese Doppelaufführung ist eine Produktion von Peter Sellars aus dem Jahr 2012 am Teatro Real in Madrid.

classica.us.title: Schubert - Vier Impromptus, op. 90
classica.us.description: Der italienische Pianist spielt unter anderem Mozarts fünfte Klaviersonate und vier Impromptus, Op. 90 von Franz Schubert. Roberto Prosseda meistert die technisch anspruchsvollen Stücke und schließt das Konzert mit Chopins Ballade Nummer vier.

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern.

classica.us.title: IVC 2021 - Finale: Schumann, Sibelius u. a
classica.us.description: Der Bariton Arvid Fagerfjäll und der Pianist Hikaru Kanki führen "Lust der Sturmnacht" aus Robert Schumanns Kerner-Liedern, Op. 35 auf. Diese Aufführung wurde in der Verkadefabriek in 's-Hertogenbosch, Niederlande, aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: Bach - 4. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs sechs Brandenburgische Konzerte gehören zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 4 in G-Dur.

classica.us.title: Jaroussky singt Bach & Telemann
classica.us.description: Mit Unterstützung des Freiburger Barockorchesters widmete sich Philippe Jaroussky den Kantaten Bachs und Telemanns. Die Musikdokumentation begleitet Jaroussky zu den CD-Aufnahmen in Freiburg und gibt Einblicke in die präzise Arbeit des Künstlers.

classica.us.title: Solos für Klarinette - Teil I
classica.us.description: Der große Klarinettist Paolo Beltramini spielt auf Stingray Brava Solostücke für Klarinette. Er spielt das Solfeggietto von C.P.E. Bach, die Hommage à Paganini von Béla Kovács und die Drei Stücke für Klarinette solo von Igor Strawinsky.

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Zubin Mehta
classica.us.description: Der indische Dirigent Zubin Mehta wurde 1977 Musikdirektor des Israel Philharmonic Orchestra ernannt. Ein intimer Blick wird auf den Dialog zwischen Mehta und den Mitgliedern des Orchesters geworfen, während sie Strauss' Tondichtung proben.

classica.us.title: Mozart - 23. Klavierkonzerte, KV 488
classica.us.description: Francesco Attesti gilt als einer der besten Interpreten des romantischen Repertoires. Zusammen mit dem Dirigenten Paolo Belloli und dem OIDA-Orchester spielt er die Klavierkonzerte Nr. 14 und 23, KV 449 und KV 488 von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart.

classica.us.title: Mahler - 2. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Das Lucerne Festival Orchestra, das 2003 gegründet wurde, präsentiert eine fantastische Interpretation von Gustav Mahlers "Auferstehung" unter der Leitung von Dirigent Claudio Abbado. Die Solistinnen werden vom "Orfeón Donostiarra"-Chor begleitet.

classica.us.title: Die drei Leben der Clara Schumann
classica.us.description: Die Biografie von Clara Schumann ist legendenumwoben: Ihre strenge Kindheit, ihr außergewöhnliches Talent als Pianistin, ihre frühe Liebe zum Komponisten Robert Schumann und die Erziehung von sieben Kindern bieten Material für Mythen und Klischees.

classica.us.title: Richard Strauss - Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40
classica.us.description: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchester in einem Konzert mit Richard Strauss' Tondichtung Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Der Violin-Solist ist David Radzynski. Aufgenommen in der Severance Hall in Cleveland im Februar 2023.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Cookin' With Cutty
spectrumoc16.us.description: Cutty and gardening students explore Waimea's Hawaii Farming, learning to grow Keiki Greens. They craft pizzas and homemade sauce with Chef Jay, and meet innovators creating 3D-printed stethoscopes for global communities in need.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Showcase Hawaii
spectrumoc16.us.description: The Puanani Plumeria Earrings feature realistic, vibrant enamel flowers beautifully accented in polished gold plating. A petite 3/8-inch design, it's colorful and easy to wear.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Hawaii Skin Diver

spectrumoc16.us.title: Hawaii Goes Fishing ᴺᵉʷ
spectrumoc16.us.description: New inventions are tested like a menpachicatching gadget, a bait rig that brings the dead back to life, and a new trolling rig. Also, learn how to tie a fly for fly fishing, prepare a ceviche recipe in the great outdoorsand take a dent out of a prop.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Outside Hawaii ᴺᵉʷ
spectrumoc16.us.description: A look at a silent crisis: water quality, and its direct impact on ocean and human health. Across the islands, meet the communities, scientists, and leaders joining forces to tackle the challenges of water quality that affect all of us.

spectrumoc16.us.title: The Joy of Crafting
spectrumoc16.us.description: Rendall Madarang makes a pumpkin from chenille stems; Leona Ahlo and Brandon Tavares share new DIY aquarium projects; Brandon creates maple leaves from chenille stems and adds them to chenille pumpkins for a beautiful fall garland.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Fashion Sense by Valerie ᴺᵉʷ
spectrumoc16.us.description: Explore vibrant Indian fashion, the traditions of Navratri in Hawai'i, and flavorful chai creations. Get expert insights on women's health, lash care, and real estate.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Everything Hawaii ᴺᵉʷ
spectrumoc16.us.description: Discover the history of David Douglas and his namesake tree. Learn about Kamehameha's exploits at the Battle of Moku'ohai. Run through lava fields, take a night dive with majestic mantas, hear from a UH Hilo athlete and stories of old Hawaii.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Ocean Paddler TV ᴺᵉʷ

spectrumoc16.us.title: Flippin Uce

spectrumoc16.us.title: The Pet Hui
spectrumoc16.us.description: Meet one very lucky pup getting the ultimate at-home spa day - a soothing massage from his owner with a handheld massager. Judging by his reaction, he can't get enough!

spectrumoc16.us.title: Ultimate Japan
spectrumoc16.us.description: The Hawaii folks take a ride on the bullet train to Tokyo. They'll savor a special chanko nabe lunch and watch an exciting sumo show. Then it's off to Toyosu Senkyaku Banrai for shopping followed by a stunning Japanese dinner.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Island Driver
spectrumoc16.us.description: Head out to the Westside to witness backyard drag racing from local modified pickup trucks to full-on dragsters.

spectrumoc16.us.title: Hawaiian Xtreme Sports TV

abcentertains.au.title: Portrait Artist Of The Year - Alexa Chung, Nish Kumar, Philip Glenister
abcentertains.au.description: In this third heat, nine artists are challenged to create a portrait of one of three celebrities: fashion model, designer and presenter Alexa Chung, comedian Nish Kumar and actor Philip Glenister. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: If You're Listening - Who's really bankrolling Nigel Farage?
abcentertains.au.description: Nigel Farage's fixer advertised money laundering on the dark web. His biggest donor's diamond mines didn't actually exist. Now Farage is being paid to promote gold and crypto. So who's really bankrolling him? (News)

abcentertains.au.title: QI - Antidotes
abcentertains.au.description: Lining up to tackle the tricky questions on this episode are Alan Davies, Danny Baker, Jo Brand and Howard Goodall. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Adventure Time - What Have You Done?
abcentertains.au.description: Finn and Jake befriend the Ice King in an attempt to save the ice cream people. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: We Baby Bears - Baby Bear Genius
abcentertains.au.description: Ice Bear receives an invitation to attend a prestigious school for baby geniuses' but Grizz and Panda do not. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Teen Titans Go! - Lil' Dimples
abcentertains.au.description: Raven enters a beauty pageant - thinking it's a way to reconnect with her father. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls - Sugar, Spice, and Super Lice
abcentertains.au.description: When Buttercup gets super lice, her sisters must battle them to save her. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir - Troublemaker
abcentertains.au.description: Jagged Stone's assistant Penny gets akumatized into Troublemaker. She used to solve other people's problems; now she's going to cause all the problems! Ladybug and Cat Noir must stop her before she gets everyone into trouble! (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Malory Towers - The Birthday Surprise
abcentertains.au.description: Ruth and Connie have received a camera for their birthday, but when the mischievous second formers take a comedic photo of Matron, they have to work to retrieve the film! (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Odd Squad - Happy Halfiversary
abcentertains.au.description: Otis discovers he's forgotten an important event in his partnership with Olympia. Now, with Oona and Ms O providing assistance, he sets off on an odd adventure to set things right. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: We Bare Bears - Bro Brawl
abcentertains.au.description: The Bears participate in a brother-themed game show. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Little Lunch - The Lost And Found Box
abcentertains.au.description: After Debra-Jo loses her glasses the children take her to the Lost and Found box to look for them, where they discover all their long-lost own belongings.

abcentertains.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire - The Winner by a Nosepass
abcentertains.au.description: Armed with Pikachu's new Iron Tail attack, Ash challenges Gym Leader Roxanne! (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Transformers: Earthspark - Warzone
abcentertains.au.description: Robby and Mo join the Terrans on a visit to the Spacebridge Memorial Park, but the memory of the siege opens old wounds.and more.for Megatron. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Adventure Time - Web Weirdos
abcentertains.au.description: When Finn gets trapped in a giant spider web, he ends up playing marriage counselor to a couple of grumpy arachnids. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Teen Titans Go! - Squash and Stretch
abcentertains.au.description: The Titans learn about cartoon-style violence to get revenge. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Teen Titans Go! - Garage Sale
abcentertains.au.description: Robin makes the others Titans sell their treasured mementos from the past episodes. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Console
abcentertains.au.description: When Gumball is given a cursed videogame console, Elmore becomes trapped inside a fantasy RPG world. Gumball, Darwin and Anais have to battle their way through town, unraveling the secrets of their new virtual reality. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Super Happy Magic Forest - The Merhaven Song Contest
abcentertains.au.description: The heroes quest to collect bath sponges from Merhaven, but Hoofius decides to enter the annual Merhaven Song Contest, causing mayhem in Merhaven. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Submarine Jim - Detective Cyril
abcentertains.au.description: The sub's steering wheel has disappeared! Fortunately, the crew includes a detective: Cyril. This time, he's in charge, and Jim will have to be his assistant. How will the two of them handle the situation? (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Total Dramarama - Sharing is Caring
abcentertains.au.description: Courtney refuses to share her valuable collectors item toy with her classmates. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir - Dearest Family
abcentertains.au.description: Shadow Moth creates Sentibubbler, a fearsome Sentimonster that will only stop if Rena Rouge betrays Ladybug and Cat Noir! Will our heroes pass this trust test? (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Ninjago - Versus
abcentertains.au.description: In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Learn A Word - Girl
abcentertains.au.description: Learn to spell and write the word Girl. This series shows an easy way to learn the basic words used in English, based on the Australian National Curriculum. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Wonderblocks - Moo!
abcentertains.au.description: It's Cow's big moment in the concert but she just can't moo at the right time. Go, Stop and Do Block Moo help Cow get her confidence back just in time for the show.

abcentertains.au.title: Colourblocks - Silly Colouring
abcentertains.au.description: The Colourblocks discover that it can be fun to colour things the wrong colour. Learn about choosing colours with the Colourblocks. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Numberblocks - Number Rescue Go
abcentertains.au.description: The Numberland Rescue Team take on a series of urgent missions to help Numberblobs in trouble. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures - Super Problems AT the Library!
abcentertains.au.description: When Mr. More sets cats and bats loose, the creatures start wrecking the library! (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know? - How Does It Work? Electric Car
abcentertains.au.description: Maddie visits an electric car factory. She learns how an electric car uses batteries and electricity to make the energy it needs to move.

abcentertains.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior - Are You A Fungi?
abcentertains.au.description: Fungi is awesome! Hannah, Savy and Gen explore amazing fungi and learn about different species in the wild. The kids and Hannah make mushroom spore print art from Portobello mushrooms. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Operation Ouch! Do Try This at Home - Membranes
abcentertains.au.description: Dr Chris and Dr Xand have brought their lab into Xand's kitchen! In today's episode, the doctors look at cell membranes, and show you an experiment to make eggs bounce!

abcentertains.au.title: Science Max: Experiments at Large - Solids, Liquids And Gases
abcentertains.au.description: Solid, Liquid, Gas and all things in-between. Phil fills a giant trough with corn starch mud to see if it's solid enough to run across. Plus, makes a giant sledgehammer out of a frozen pumpkin and giant rock candy. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Atom Bond - Bond Another Day
abcentertains.au.description: In a secret location, Copper and Silver separate Chlorine from Potassium. Gold & Chlorine return to Carbon's secret school - but cannot find Fluorine & Oxygen. Carbon appears, and Gold and Chlorine flee to a nearby bond shop. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Dr Karl's How Things Work - Pies
abcentertains.au.description: Guided by a pie-tastic team in Perth, Dr Karl embarks on a culinary odyssey to uncover how Australia's iconic meat pies are made. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces - Garden Tailor and a Cabin in the Sky
abcentertains.au.description: John, a tailor from London, dreams of creating his own office space in the garden so he can spend more time closer to home after the arrival of a newborn baby. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Not Going Out - Enough
abcentertains.au.description: Are Lee and Lucy ready for another child? Lucy isn't keen, so Lee applies reverse psychology, saying that he abides by her wishes. Lee is soon in for a shock when Lucy calls his bluff and suggests a vasectomy. (Comedy)

abcentertains.au.title: Spooks
abcentertains.au.description: Accused of murder, Tom Quinn is on the run. Can his team prove him innocent? (Drama)

abcentertains.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
abcentertains.au.description: George visits an American school bus home that has been four years in the making, a Dutch tiny home that can be reconfigured four ways and low-cost housing pods designed to help tackle homelessness. (Final). (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: ER - Fevers of Unknown Origin
abcentertains.au.description: Susan throws herself into her work to escape her personal woes. Doug takes up with his father's girlfriend. Shep attacks a boy who is meddling at a scene. Mark and Jenn discuss their divorce amicably, with unforeseen results. (Drama)

abcentertains.au.title: Like A Version - triple j - Ethel Cain

abcmelbourne.au.title: Insiders

abcmelbourne.au.title: News Breakfast ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E213 Monday 26 October 2026 News Breakfast gives you the morning advantage. James Glenday and Emma Rebellato bring you the latest news, sport with Catherine Murphy and weather with Nate Byrne. Don't just start your day informed, start your day in front.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Stuff The British Stole

abcmelbourne.au.title: ABC News At Noon ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E213 Monday 26 October 2026 The leading news at lunchtime. Kathryn Robinson brings you the day's top stories and the latest news as it unfolds, with reporters in the community across Australia and around the world reporting on the issues that matter.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Landline
abcmelbourne.au.description: E37 A tasty sampler of stories from the land - covering food, agriculture, crops, climate, business and innovation - as we meet the fascinating people who make our rural and regional communities unique. Presented by Pip Courtney.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Parliament Question Time ᴺᵉʷ

abcmelbourne.au.title: Grand Designs Australia

abcmelbourne.au.title: Long Lost Family

abcmelbourne.au.description: S47 E19 Botanic Gardens, Belfast 3 The Roadshow returns to Beaumaris Castle, Anglesey, where finds include trophies from the Isle of Man TT race, a dog collar from 1765 and work by local artist Charles Tunnicliffe.

abcmelbourne.au.title: 7.30 ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E169 Sarah Ferguson presents Australia's premier daily current affairs program, delivering agenda-setting public affairs journalism and interviews that hold the powerful to account. Plus political analysis from Jacob Greber.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Australian Story ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E35 Unbeaten - Usman Khawaja Usman Khawaja retired as one of the greats of Australian cricket but the Pakistan-born batsman struggled throughout his career to belong. Now he's determined to change that for the next generation of migrant kids.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Four Corners ᴺᵉʷ

abcmelbourne.au.title: Media Watch ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E38 Australia's leading forum for media analysis and comment. Walkley award-winning investigative reporter and former foreign correspondent Linton Besser brings you a fearless critique of the week's journalism.

abcmelbourne.au.description: E33 With just over one week to go until the Midterm Elections, Chas and John bring you the state of the races, the key battlegrounds to watch, the latest polls and controversies as American voters decide who'll control Congress.

abcmelbourne.au.title: The State Of Man
abcmelbourne.au.description: S1 E2 Episode 2 Marc Fennell meets red pill gurus, a former incel, a trad wife and steroid fuelled influencers to uncover who's really profiting from the manosphere - and who is left paying the price.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Accidental Getaway Driver
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: During a routine pickup, an elderly Vietnamese cab driver is taken hostage at gunpoint by three recently escaped Orange County convicts.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: The Loss Of A Teardrop Diamond
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Set in 1920s Mississippi, this film follows the tumultuous romance between a rebellious socialite and the handsome young man she hires as her escort.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Master Cheng
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Following the death of his wife, professional chef Cheng travels with his young son to a remote village in Finland to connect with an old Finnish friend he once met in Shanghai.

sbsworldmoviesperth.au.title: Alick & Albert
sbsworldmoviesperth.au.description: Even though they live worlds apart, Torres Strait artist and activist Alick Tipoti and His Serene Highness Prince Albert II of Monaco unite to help protect the Ocean.
